name: Bang Tao — Angsana Lake view Royal Villa 116/19 · 4 bedrooms
description:
Angsana Lake View Royal Villa 116/19 is a spacious 4-bedroom family residence located in the prestigious 5-star Angsana Villas complex, in the heart of the Laguna Phuket resort.

This two-story villa is designed in a modern Asian style, combining homely warmth, premium comfort, and picturesque views of a tropical lake. It is the perfect choice for a large family or group of friends who appreciate developed infrastructure and high-level service.

The villa’s design features light, natural tones and high-quality natural materials, emphasizing harmony with the surrounding environment. Panoramic windows and spacious terraces on both floors flood the space with natural light, while views of the calm lake and tropical garden create an atmosphere of serenity and privacy.

The villa offers two living areas for maximum guest comfort.

Ground Floor: A bright living room connected to the kitchen, with direct access to the pool.

Second Floor: An additional cozy living area opening onto a scenic terrace.

Both zones are furnished with plush sofas, TVs, and air conditioning, creating ideal conditions for social gatherings or quiet relaxation.

The modern kitchen on the ground floor is fully equipped for a comfortable stay:

The space is thoughtfully designed to make cooking your favorite meals easy and enjoyable, even while on vacation. Nearby there is a dining area for 8 people with a view of the pool.

The villa features 4 comfortable bedrooms intelligently distributed across two floors. All rooms are equipped with air conditioning and wardrobes.

Ground Floor: A bedroom with a Queen-size bed — ideal for guests or elderly family members as it requires no stairs. A bathroom with a shower is located nearby.

Master Bedroom: A spacious room with a King-size bed, terrace access, and a private ensuite bathroom.

Two Guest Bedrooms: Cozy and bright rooms sharing a common bathroom on the floor.

The villa’s focal point is the private ground-floor terrace with a personal pool and lake views.

Here you will find sun loungers and a cozy gazebo (sala), perfect for enjoying morning coffee or evening cocktails in the fresh air.

The villa is situated in one of Phuket's most sought-after locations — Laguna Phuket.

5 minutes to Boat Avenue and Porto de Phuket shopping galleries with restaurants and Villa Market supermarket.

7 minutes to the pristine white sands of Bang Tao Beach and beach clubs like Catch, Xana, and Maya.

Angsana Lake View Royal Villa 116/19 is where family comfort meets the privileges of a 5-star resort. Here, you can enjoy the privacy of your own villa while having the entire infrastructure of Laguna Phuket at your fingertips. The ideal choice for those seeking a carefree, vibrant, and stylish vacation in Phuket.

When choosing a place to stay on Phuket Island, consider the Rawai Grand House and Villas hotel complex, which meets all modern standards of comfort, style, and service.

The complex welcomed its first guests in December 2009. Whether you’re traveling with family, a group of friends, or a corporate team, you can enjoy a short or extended unforgettable vacation here. You will immerse yourself in and truly experience authentic Thai hospitality.

Its unique location—in the southernmost part of the island, nestled between Nai Harn and Rawai beaches—is just one of the hotel’s many advantages. It offers a remarkable blend of simplicity and style, coziness and elegance. From the hotel windows, you can enjoy breathtaking panoramic views of the mountains. The peaceful surroundings, birdsong, and comfortable, well-appointed furniture all create the perfect atmosphere for a relaxing getaway.

The Rawai Grand House and Villas hotel complex offers the best combination of price and quality, with a personalized approach to every guest. Its convenient location allows you to easily reach either the pristine white sandy beaches with crystal-clear waters or the heart of the local infrastructure. Proximity to the sea means gentle breezes and a refreshing microclimate. The Rawai-Nai Harn area will delight you with its variety of seafood restaurants, bars, cozy cafes, nightclubs, and stunning landscapes.

Guests at Rawai Grand House and Villas can choose from 12 standard rooms, 4 upgraded standard rooms with private entrances, and 4 suites featuring a living room and separate bedroom. For family vacations or groups of friends, there are 4 suites with living rooms, modern kitchens, and three bedrooms, or 8 comfortable three-bedroom private villas. All rooms and villas are equipped with bathrooms, air conditioning, LCD TVs (with Russian and international satellite channels), DVD players, telephones, internet access, and refrigerators. Higher-category rooms offer additional amenities and equipment. Those who choose a villa can enjoy their stay surrounded by a beautiful tropical garden, take advantage of a large private pool with a jacuzzi, parking for two cars, and cozy modern furnishings.

The Rawai Grand House complex is located in the south of Phuket, a few kilometres from Naiharn Beach. A guarded complex on the territory of which there is a building with apartments of different types - 12 Superior Rooms, 4 Grand Superior with an area of ​​58 m2, 4 Deluxe suites with an area of ​​65 m2, 4 grand suites - three-bedroom apartments with an area of ​​121 m2 and 8 two-storey villas, with private swimming pools, spacious gardens and private covered parking.

The complex with 24-hour security and many amenities that have been created for the well-being and health of guests: the complex has a fully equipped gym, Russian sauna, jacuzzi, a large 25-meter pool with a special children's area and a restaurant.

The complex is well located in relation to the entire tourist infrastructure of the Naiharn and Rawai areas. Just a few minutes walk, and you will find yourself on the Rawai embankment. Rawai is not a very comfortable beach for swimming because of the frequent low tide. But along the beach there is a picturesque promenade with fish restaurants, and in its eastern part there is a sea gypsy market, famous in Phuket, where fresh and live seafood is sold. The nearest bathing beach - Nai Harn is a 10-minute drive from the villa. The beach is popular with families with children and expats, so you will not find a large crowd of tourists here. It is comfortable to spend your vacation here, because Nearby there are many restaurants like European, and national Thai cuisine. There are also offices with transport rental and excursion services.

There is an international school within a few minutes drive from the complex. Also, within a radius of 5-10 kilometres there are Russian and Thai kindergartens, international and Russian schools.

In the Rawai district and in the neighbouring Naiharn district, there are gyms, specialized rings for Thai boxing and workout grounds. In 7-10 minutes drive there is a hyper market Makro, a supermarket with European products Villa Market, a fish market. Super grocery stores: Tesco Lotus, Macro, Villa Market, seafood market in Rawai, many convenience stores (7-Eleven Super Cheap, Family Mart).

The complex is ideal for long term stays and short vacations. Spacious villas will accommodate large families, while cosy apartments are ideal for couples of all ages. It is especially comfortable to stay here for families with children.

It offers 1 bedroom. Total area is 58 m². The sea is approximately 900 m away. The unit is part of Rawai Grand House.

Its crystal-clear turquoise water, white sand, and gentle entry into the sea make it ideal for swimming with children. Here, you can rent mattresses and umbrellas, which is now a rare convenience in Phuket.

The Calypso condominium offers a choice of one- and two-bedroom apartments ranging from 33 sq.m. up to luxury apartments of 73 sq.m. In total, the complex has 46 units. The complex offers secure parking, a swimming pool, a reception area, and a small gym. Restaurants, supermarkets, and massage salons are just a two-minute walk from the complex.

description:

If you love walking to the sea, then the new Calypso complex in the south of the island is just for you.

The name of the complex was chosen deliberately. Calypso – in ancient Greek mythology – is a beautiful nymph, the owner of the mythical island of Ogygia, who lives surrounded by stunning nature, in the shade of trees, in peace and tranquility. It is in such a place that this complex is located, which we want to present for your comfortable stay.

Just a few minutes’ walk, most of it shaded by trees along a beautiful lake, and you will find yourself on one of the island’s most remarkable beaches – Nai Harn. This beach is one of the best in Phuket, flanked on both sides by palm groves, creating the impression of a magical lagoon. The beach stretches about 1 km, with a width of up to 50 meters, crystal-clear turquoise water, white sand, and a gentle entry into the sea, making it ideal for swimming with children. Here you can rent mattresses and umbrellas, which is now quite rare in Phuket.

The Calypso condominium offers you a choice of one-bedroom and two-bedroom apartments ranging from 33 sq.m. to luxury apartments of 73 sq.m. There are a total of 46 units in the complex. All apartments feature unique designs created specifically for this complex and high-quality finishes. The one-bedroom apartments, starting at 33 sq.m., consist of a separate bedroom with a double bed, a living room combined with a fully equipped kitchen with a breakfast bar, a washing machine, a bathroom with a shower cabin, and a balcony furnished with outdoor furniture. All ground-floor apartments have direct access to the pool.

The complex offers secure parking, a swimming pool, and a reception area. Restaurants, supermarkets, and massage salons are just a two-minute walk from the complex.

The interior of each apartment is designed in soft, light tones. Clever design solutions have made it possible to create a spacious feel even in the smallest units. This cozy 36 sqm studio successfully accommodates a double bed, bedside tables, a wardrobe, a fold-out sofa with a lounge area, a fully equipped kitchen, and a dining space.

The Title Nai Yang is a modern resort complex, which consists of seven buildings of 6 and 7 floors and has 472 apartments: studios 36-39m2, one-bedroom apartments with an area of ​​46m2 or two

The interior of each apartment is designed in soft, light tones. Clever design solutions have made it possible to create a spacious feel even in the smallest units. This cozy 36 sqm studio successfully accommodates a double bed, bedside tables, a wardrobe, a fold-out sofa with a lounge area, a fully equipped kitchen, and a dining space.

The Title Nai Yang is a modern resort complex, which consists of seven buildings of 6 and 7 floors and has 472 apartments: studios 36-39m2, one-bedroom apartments with an area of ​​46m2 or two bedrooms, the territory of the complex itself is fenced and is under 24-hour video surveillance and security ... The concept of the project and design is somewhat unusual for Thailand, the complex is decorated with red brick, and it looks more like a medieval castle than a modern Asian condominium. The apartments have a comfortable layout, in light grey and blue colours. The common area is a beautiful, well-groomed recreation park, a river flows along the buildings, which gives the project a certain charm and beauty of the fusion of modern urban architecture with nature.

The complex has its own restaurant, which serves breakfast, lunch and dinner a-la carte. Each building has access to a communal pool and well-kept garden. 5 swimming pools in each building are located on the 1st floor, and the sixth is on the roof of one of the buildings. There is a recreation area on the same roof. The complex offers a free gym, two saunas, a reception, a play area for children in the form of a pirate ship. Parking for 240 cars is organized on the south side of the building and is separated by green spaces and a fence.

The complex blends in perfectly with the tropical environment, and walking to the beach is a real pleasure. Just 5 minutes, and you will find yourself on one of the most stunning beaches in Phuket - Nai Yang. A small, cosy beach with a length of just under 3 kilometres, the water area of ​​which is protected by coral reefs, will allow you to enjoy swimming in the sea all year round, regardless of the season. Since 1986, this beach has been part of the Sirinath National Park Marine Park and all motor sports are prohibited on it. There is a large selection of restaurants, bars and cafés along the beach. The Title project itself separates the famous 5 * hotel The Slate from the beach with excellent gourmet restaurants. A five-minute walk is a local grocery market and mini markets.

The proximity to the sea and low prices make this project one of the most attractive on the island. And the peculiarity of the Nai Yang beach, on which there are never waves, even in low season, makes the project popular all year round. The entrance to the water is very shallow, so the beach is loved by families with small children. The low cost of apartments, both for rent and for purchase, makes the project accessible to everyone.
specs: Lifestyle for Expats in Nai Yang

A unique complex in Phuket offering incredibly comfortable living conditions at a very affordable price. And yet, you won’t have to compromise on the level of service.

This project has virtually no drawbacks. We assure you, it will become one of the best places where you’ve ever spent your vacation! And now you’ll understand why. First – a convenient location. The complex is situated right on the shoreline of Rawai Beach, in the heart of a well-developed tourist infrastructure and close to famous attractions known throughout Asia. Although the beach itself isn’t suitable for swimming, you can easily reach the neighboring Nai Harn Beach in just a few minutes on a special free shuttle bus, where you can swim to your heart’s content and sunbathe on pristine white sand. Second – the complex is brand new; neither the apartments nor the furniture have lost their original shine and luster. Third – truly royal service. Fourth – a large, well-maintained green area with two communal swimming pools featuring a special children’s zone. The grounds also include two saunas, a restaurant, a gym, a reception desk, and 24-hour security. And finally – the complex is within walking distance of countless restaurants, night bars, banks, souvenir shops, scenic viewpoints with breathtaking ocean views, and a fresh seafood market. By the way, you can even have your seafood cooked right there in one of the nearby restaurants.

The 63 m² apartments feature two bedrooms, a living room, a kitchen, and a balcony. The kitchen is fully equipped with everything you need: dishes, a refrigerator, a kettle, and a microwave.

Now, let’s be honest. Everyone loves the sea; there’s no one who doesn’t enjoy warm sunshine and stunning tropical nature. No one who wouldn’t want to celebrate New Year’s near the equator, escaping the endless Russian winter. To feel the festive scent of tangerines mixed with the freshest sea breeze. All of this can be found in Phuket, and experienced in this magnificent complex. Welcome to the island!

The Title Rawai condominium is located on the southernmost point of Phuket Island. 20 meters from the popular Rawai promenade and in the very centre of the developed tourist infrastructure of the southern part of the island. The complex is divided into two parts. The first phase was commissioned in 2016, it consists of 7 buildings with elevators of 4 floors, the second phase is absolutely identical in architecture, it differs only in the year of construction, it is newer - it was commissioned in 2018. A recognizable feature of the project is the landscape design, families with children fell in love with this place for the green area and large swimming pools with a children's area, as well as for the opportunity for children to play completely safely on the territory of the complex and be absolutely calm for their safety, because the territory is guarded 24 hours a day. Young couples choose it for its privacy and the opportunity to spend romantic evenings in small restaurants on the seashore, which are located across the street from the complex. Elderly couples appreciate the incredibly comfortable conditions and the level of service, as well as the opportunity to get literally in a matter of minutes to the neighbouring Naiharn beach to swim and sunbathe on the white sand. Young guys and girls for the opportunity to make morning and evening jogging along the wide embankment in the shade of trees and for yoga classes right on the seashore, and in the evening for the opportunity to relax in one of the spa salons, which are located right next to the complex. And of course, everyone who loves to have fun fell in love with this place because there are numerous bars and restaurants within walking distance of the fish market, famous throughout Phuket.

Large and well-groomed green area with communal pools with a special children's area, there is also a sauna, reception and 24-hour security and parking on the territory.

The complex has studio apartments, 1 bedroom and 2-bedroom apartments with balcony or garden access, which have bedrooms, living room with TV, fully equipped kitchen, where you will find everything you need: dishes, refrigerator, kettle and microwave oven and balcony.

The complex is located 2 km from the observation deck "Windmill" and in km from Cape Promthep. Phuket Seashell Museum is 2.8 km away. Phuket International Airport is 49 km away.

One of the best beaches - Naiharn is located 4 kilometres from the project. The beach is popular with families with children and expats, so you will not find a large crowd of tourists here. A stone's throw from the beach, there is a freshwater lake and an observation deck with windmills. Naiharn Beach is popular with families with children, as well as with winterers and long-livers of the island. It is comfortable to spend your holiday here, because Nearby there are many restaurants like European, and national Thai cuisine. There are also offices with transport rental and excursion services. For a long stay on Naiharn, it is comfortable to live for families with children - there are international and Thai kindergartens, international and Russian schools nearby. The way from Naiharn to the popular children's play complex "Rawai Park" will take 5 minutes by car or bike.

These apartments stand out from the standard units in the complex for all the right reasons.

The Title Rawai condominium is located on the southernmost point of Phuket Island. 20 meters from the popular Rawai promenade and in the very centre of the developed tourist infrastructure of the southern part of the island. Large and well-groomed green area with communal pools with a special children's area, there is also a sauna, reception and 24-hour security and parking on the territory.

This is one of the most popular projects in Phuket. Our tourists who have visited here once keep coming back again and again. This complex has won over everyone without exception.

Families with children love this place for its lush green grounds and large swimming pools with a kids’ area, as well as the opportunity for children to play safely within the complex, giving parents complete peace of mind since the area is guarded 24 hours a day. Young couples choose it for its privacy and the chance to enjoy romantic evenings at the small seaside restaurants located just across the road from the complex. Older couples appreciate the incredibly comfortable conditions and high level of service, as well as the convenience of a special free shuttle bus that takes you in just minutes to the nearby Nai Harn Beach, where you can swim and sunbathe on pristine white sand. Young men and women enjoy the opportunity for morning and evening jogs along the wide tree-lined promenade and practicing yoga right on the beach, while evenings can be spent relaxing at one of the spa salons located right next to the complex. And of course, everyone who loves to have fun adores this place because numerous bars and restaurants are within walking distance.

The project has virtually no downsides. We assure you it will become one of the best places where you’ve ever spent your vacation. The complex is located right on the seafront, along Rawai Promenade, amidst a well-developed tourist infrastructure and close to famous attractions known throughout Asia.

The large, well-maintained green area features shared swimming pools with a dedicated children’s zone. The complex also includes a sauna, reception, 24-hour security, and parking.

The apartments offer bedrooms, a living room with a TV, a fully equipped kitchen where you’ll find everything you need: dishes, refrigerator, kettle, and microwave, plus a balcony.

The Title Rawai condominium is located on the southernmost point of Phuket Island. 20 meters from the popular Rawai promenade and in the very centre of the developed tourist infrastructure of the southern part of the island. The complex is divided into two parts. The first phase was commissioned in 2016, it consists of 7 buildings with elevators of 4 floors, the second phase is absolutely identical in architecture, it differs only in the year of construction, it is newer - it was commissioned in 2018. A recognizable feature of the project is the landscape design, families with children fell in love with this place for the green area and large swimming pools with a children's area, as well as for the opportunity for children to play completely safely on the territory of the complex and be absolutely calm for their safety, because the territory is guarded 24 hours a day. Young couples choose it for its privacy and the opportunity to spend romantic evenings in small restaurants on the seashore, which are located across the street from the complex. Elderly couples appreciate the incredibly comfortable conditions and the level of service, as well as the opportunity to get literally in a matter of minutes to the neighbouring Naiharn beach to swim and sunbathe on the white sand. Young guys and girls for the opportunity to make morning and evening jogging along the wide embankment in the shade of trees and for yoga classes right on the seashore, and in the evening for the opportunity to relax in one of the spa salons, which are located right next to the complex. And of course, everyone who loves to have fun fell in love with this place because there are numerous bars and restaurants within walking distance of the fish market, famous throughout Phuket.

Large and well-groomed green area with communal pools with a special children's area, there is also a sauna, reception and 24-hour security and parking on the territory.

The complex has studio apartments, 1 bedroom and 2-bedroom apartments with balcony or garden access, which have bedrooms, living room with TV, fully equipped kitchen, where you will find everything you need: dishes, refrigerator, kettle and microwave oven and balcony.

The complex is located 2 km from the observation deck "Windmill" and in km from Cape Promthep. Phuket Seashell Museum is 2.8 km away. Phuket International Airport is 49 km away.

One of the best beaches - Naiharn is located 4 kilometres from the project. The beach is popular with families with children and expats, so you will not find a large crowd of tourists here. A stone's throw from the beach, there is a freshwater lake and an observation deck with windmills. Naiharn Beach is popular with families with children, as well as with winterers and long-livers of the island. It is comfortable to spend your holiday here, because Nearby there are many restaurants like European, and national Thai cuisine. There are also offices with transport rental and excursion services. For a long stay on Naiharn, it is comfortable to live for families with children - there are international and Thai kindergartens, international and Russian schools nearby. The way from Naiharn to the popular children's play complex "Rawai Park" will take 5 minutes by car or bike.

description:
2-Bedroom Apartments, with pool view in Baan Puri project, on Surin beach

The complex consists of four buildings and is located just 1 km, or a 15-minute walk, from two of Phuket’s most beautiful beaches – Surin and Bang Tao. These beaches are among the best on the island, so you won’t be disappointed with this location.

The complex consists of four buildings and is located just 1 km, or a 15-minute walk, from two of Phuket’s most beautiful beaches – Surin and Bang Tao. These beaches are among the best on the island, so you won’t be disappointed with this location.

Guests can enjoy two-bedroom apartments featuring a kitchen and balcony. Each apartment includes a spacious living room with a comfortable seating area and TV, two bedrooms (one with a double bed and two with single beds), and one bathroom. The kitchen is fully equipped with modern appliances and cookware, finished with marble surfaces. The balcony overlooks the pool and patio area.

The complex boasts a huge 50-meter landscaped swimming pool with a children’s section. On-site, there is a restaurant and poolside bar serving Thai cuisine throughout the day. Guests also have access to a gym, sauna, and spa center, all open daily.

This property is perfect for both short vacations and long-term rentals. The friendly staff are your great allies and are ready to assist you at any time of day.

Located 700 meters from Bang Tao Beach, Baan Puri Complex offers well-equipped apartments with modern kitchens and private balconies. The complex has an outdoor pool, children's pool, fitness center and a restaurant and pool bar.

Surin Beach is a 10-minute walk from Baan Puri Apartments. Patong Beach is a 15-minute drive away. Phuket International Airport is a 30-minute drive away. Free parking is available.

The modern, bright and spacious apartments have an open-plan kitchen and dining area. The kitchen is finished in marble or granite with an oven and a cooker hood. The apartment has a comfortable seating area and a spacious bathroom.

The project is located close to one of the best beaches in Phuket, Bangtao Beach. Phuket's most popular beach clubs such as Xana Beach Club, Dream Beach Club and Catch Club are located on the 8 km long beach line. The complex is located 10 minutes drive from the Boat Avenue shopping complex with many shops, countless restaurants and bars, the Villa Market European supermarket and the modern Porto De Phuket shopping complex with countless restaurants, Tors supermarket, boutiques and food court. Nearby is the Lemonade Kids Club with a children's room and a pool for children, a hot sauna for adults. The bustling party scene of Patong is a 15-minute drive from the complex. The road from the airport to the complex will take about 30 minutes.

The complex is ideal for absolutely everyone. The large size of the apartments attracts families with children. The convenient location and proximity to Patong's nightlife and accessibility to Bangtao beach clubs allows us to recommend these holiday apartments to lovers of a laid-back holiday.

description:
This 135-square-meter apartment features a living room and a compact kitchen with a dining area, two bedrooms, and two bathrooms, as well as a terrace overlooking the stunning freshwater Lagoon. The second and third floors house the two bedrooms and two bathrooms.

Guests have access to a shared swimming pool and restaurant, along with all the complex’s amenities, including a golf course, tennis courts, fitness centers, kids’ clubs, spas, pools, and beaches. Complimentary shuttle buses run regularly throughout the property.

This 135-square-meter apartment features a living room and a compact kitchen with a dining area, two bedrooms, and two bathrooms, as well as a terrace overlooking the stunning freshwater Lagoon. The second and third floors house the two bedrooms and two bathrooms.

Guests have access to a shared swimming pool and restaurant, along with all the complex’s amenities, including a golf course, tennis courts, fitness centers, kids’ clubs, spas, pools, and beaches. Complimentary shuttle buses run regularly throughout the property.

Allamanda is the first apart-hotel to be built in the heart of Laguna Phuket Resort in 2000 and is still a favourite destination for expats and guests of Phuket. The Allamanda complex consists of three three-storey buildings: Allamanda 1 is facing the sea and the fresh lake and Allamanda 2 and 3, which with all its windows overlooks the luxurious Laguna Golf course. Allamanda guests and residents can take advantage of the entire infrastructure of the huge Laguna Phuket Resort, receiving privileges in the form of discounts at the restaurants, spas and boutiques of the resort. Allamanda has 4 types of apartments: studios, one-bedroom, two-bedroom and three-story duplexes. In total, the project has 115 spacious apartments ranging from 65 to 140 m2. Allamanda attracts golf amateurs and professionals from all over the world.

Allamanda has its own bar, reception, two communal swimming pools with sun loungers and showers, minimart, walking paths. A free shuttle bus runs regularly from the complex to the beach and back. While resting in Allamanda, you do not need to rent transport - you can get to any point of the resort by shuttle bus. This is especially convenient for families with small children.

Allamanda Complex is located just a 5-10 minute walk from Bangtao Beach. This beach is where Phuket's most popular beach clubs are located, such as Xana Beach Club, Dream Beach Club and Catch Club. Laguna Phuket Golf Club is next to Allamanda and hosts international tournaments. Inexperienced golfers can use the services of a personal golf coach. A 5-minute drive from Allamanda is the Boat Avenue shopping complex with a variety of shops, countless restaurants and bars, and a European supermarket Villa Market. The modern Porto De Phuket shopping complex, with countless restaurants, Tors supermarket, boutiques and food court, is just a short drive away. Nearby is the Lemonade Kids Club with a children's room and a pool for children, a hot sauna for adults. The bustling party scene of Patong is a 30-minute drive from the complex. The road from the airport to the complex will take about 25 minutes.

Allamanda is located in one of the most prestigious areas of Phuket with developed infrastructure, but the cost of housing is relatively low. Therefore, the project is suitable for all those who prefer a measured rest surrounded by beautiful landscapes to a noisy crowd of tourists. Allamanda is loved by everyone, from young families with children to people of venerable age. Whether you rent or purchase a property in Laguna Phuket, you and your home acquire the style, lifestyle and privileges of a resident of the most prestigious Asian resort.

It offers 2 bedrooms. Total area is 135 m². The sea is approximately 700 m away. The unit is part of Allamanda 1.

description:
2-Bedroom Apartments, with sea view in Andara project, on Kamala beach

The five-star Andara complex is located on the west coast of Phuket Island, close to restaurants, shopping centers, world-class golf courses, and other entertainment options. Kamala Beach is just a 10-minute walk or a short shuttle ride away.

All residences and villas offer stunning views of the Andaman Sea. Each unit harmoniously blends natural materials, contemporary Thai design, and the perfect balance of indoor and outdoor spaces set against unforgettable landscapes.

The five-star Andara complex is located on the west coast of Phuket Island, close to restaurants, shopping centers, world-class golf courses, and other entertainment options. Kamala Beach is just a 10-minute walk or a short shuttle ride away.

All residences and villas offer stunning views of the Andaman Sea. Each unit harmoniously blends natural materials, contemporary Thai design, and the perfect balance of indoor and outdoor spaces set against unforgettable landscapes.

The complex features 37 residences with luxurious sea views. A distinctive feature of these residences is their elegant bedrooms, modern European kitchens, and spacious living rooms that open onto terraces.

The two-bedroom apartments, spanning 183 sq.m, are situated near the 40-meter communal swimming pool. Enjoy comfort and coziness in spacious residences adorned with Jim Thompson silk finishes. Guests have access to a high-quality sound system and state-of-the-art equipment. The living room opens onto a terrace where you can savor breakfast or a cocktail while watching an unforgettable sunset.

On-site is the renowned Silk restaurant, delighting guests with Thai and international cuisine. Guests can also unwind at Andara Spa, where the staff will tailor a personalized program of relaxing treatments and massages.

At the Beach Club, you can sunbathe on double loungers, swim, or enjoy water sports such as windsurfing, parasailing, or take a ride on a scooter, banana boat, or catamaran. The Beach Club is a 7-minute walk or a 2-3 minute shuttle ride from the reception, with shuttle service running from 8 AM to 6 PM. In addition to this beach, guests also have access to the Beach Lounge beach club.

Five-star hotel Andara Resort is located on the west coast of Phuket. The hotel has 26 villas and 37 luxury apartments with magnificent sea views. Respectable interior furnished with precious rocks, walls decorated with Jim Thompson silk, Thai artifacts, candles and incense along with modern equipment create an unusually sophisticated and comfortable atmosphere for a premium holiday. The area of apartments and villas: the minimum room is 153 sq. m, the maximum is 2100 sq. m!

Andara Resort has all the infrastructure of a 5* hotel. On site, guests can relax at the Andara Spa. There is an opportunity to do a hairstyle, pedicure, manicure, etc. Lovers of steam are available free access to the sauna. Fashionable SILK restaurant, pampering guests with Thai and international dishes. In SILK you can always please yourself with a variety of dishes, and of course, there is always the opportunity to order a private dinner. For children, a fun children's menu and entertainment are offered. Children's mini-club with a games room and a playground. The animation team and educators will not let the kids get bored. The fitness center is equipped with modern simulators, power stations, equipment. To choose the right training regime will help a professional coach. Group classes are also held here. Guests can work out in the gym until 8 p.m. And if you want to practice at night, they will open it on a call. In the beach club Beach Club you can sunbathe on double sunbeds, swim or do sea sports - windsurfing, parasailing, ride a scooter, banana or catamaran. The Beach Club is a 7-minute walk or a 2-3 minute shuttle ride from the reception from 8 a.m. to 6 p.m.

Phuket International Airport is located just 18 km from the hotel complex. The city centre is 20 km away. A free shuttle service to the surrounding area is available for up to 1 km. This is enough to reach the resort town of Kamala, where there are many shops, cafes, restaurants, beach clubs, such as the world-famous Cafe Del Mar, the PINE Beach Club at the Intercontinental Hotel, the HQ Beach Club. Very close (1.4 km) is the theme park Phuket Fantasea.

A place of rest for your family, friends, as a romantic oasis for your couple. All, without exception, rooms are ready to accept families with children of any age. There are rooms for non-smokers and allergy sufferers. Villas with 3-7 bedrooms are ideal for family stays, meetings of friends or for special celebrations.

Kamala combines a relaxed residential atmosphere with quick access to beach clubs, restaurants and the west coast infrastructure. It is a strong choice for lifestyle buyers and rental investors.

It offers 2 bedrooms. Total area is 183 m². The sea is approximately 400 m away. The unit is part of Andara.

The two-bedroom apartments feature an impressively functional kitchen. The two-bedroom apartments feature an impressively functional kitchen. The entire living space – bedrooms, kitchen, and lounge area – is designed in the bright and cheerful spirit of the Cassia aparthotel. From the private terrace of the apartments, guests can enjoy stunning views of the Andaman Sea.

The aparthotel is situated in a picturesque and completely safe environment, on the shore of a freshwater lake that separates it from the beach. A river shuttle boat, continuously running across the lake, transports guests from the hotel lobby to the 8-kilometer-long Bang Tao Beach in just minutes. Cassia offers its own beach club equipped with complimentary sun loungers. The shared facilities include everything needed for a comfortable stay – a children's playground and a shallow pool with sea sand for the youngest guests, a swimming pool, sun loungers, a kids’ club, a beauty salon, and a coffee shop. The hotel lobby and security operate 24/7 on the premises.

Hotel Cassia is located in the heart of Laguna Phuket Resort & Hotel Complex. It was built in 2015 and has become a favourite destination for tourists from all over the world. The hotel consists of two 6-storey buildings that are interconnected. The hotel is built in the Art Nouveau style, with very bright interiors of both the common areas and the apartments themselves. The number of rooms includes apartments with one and two bedrooms with or without a mezzanine. One bedroom apartments have a total area of ​​40-52 sq. m., mezzanine - 10-14 sq. m. Apartments with two bedrooms are more spacious - 62-86 sq. m. m. on the ground floor plus a mezzanine. All apartments have a kitchen fully equipped with household appliances and utensils and a dining table. In total, the hotel has 402 rooms, designed in the same style. The apartments offer magnificent views of the lake and the sea. Among the brands of Laguna, the Cassia apart-hotel stands out in that it is designed for a youth and active audience of holidaymakers. This is an affordable proposition, while the complex is surrounded by premium hotels, luxurious villas and world-class golf course.

The Cassia has a private beach equipped with sun loungers, a restaurant, a reception, two communal swimming pools with sun loungers and cabanas, showers and toilets, a bar and walking paths. There is a kids club for children, where you can just play and spend time. A free shuttle bus runs regularly from the complex to the beach and back. While resting at the Cassia Phuket hotel, you do not need to rent transport - by shuttle you can get to the beach, restaurants, shops, the main building. There is also a boat to the beach every half hour. This is especially convenient for families with small children. The restaurant offers in-villa or BBQ catering.

The Cassia complex is located right next to Bangtao Beach, which can be reached in 5 minutes on foot or by a free water bus that runs on the lake. This beach is where Phuket's most popular beach clubs are located, such as Xana Beach Club, Dream Beach Club and Catch Club. Next to Cassia is the Laguna Phuket golf club, where international class tournaments are held. Inexperienced golfers can use the services of a personal golf coach. Boat Avenue is a 2-minute drive from the Cassia, with a variety of shops, countless restaurants and bars, and Villa Market, a European supermarket. The modern Porto De Phuket shopping complex, with countless restaurants, Tors supermarket, boutiques and food court, is just a short drive away. Nearby is the Lemonade Kids Club with a children's room and a pool for children, a hot sauna for adults. The bustling party scene of Patong is a 30-minute drive from the complex. The road from the airport to the complex will take about 25 minutes.

The hotel is located in one of the most prestigious areas of Phuket with developed infrastructure, but at the same time it is the most budget hotel in the Laguna. Therefore, Cassia is to the liking of many categories of tourists, for whom the main thing is a high level of accommodation and a good location. Whether you rent or purchase a property in Laguna Phuket, you and your home acquire the style, lifestyle and privileges of a resident of the most prestigious Asian resort.

It is in such a place that this complex is located, which we want to present for your comfortable stay.

Just a few minutes’ walk—most of it shaded by trees along a beautiful lake—and you’ll find yourself at one of the island’s most remarkable beaches: Nai Harn. This beach is one of the best in Phuket, flanked on both sides by palm groves, creating the impression of a magical lagoon. The beach stretches about 1 km long and up to 50 meters wide, with crystal-clear turquoise water, white sand, and a gently sloping entry into the sea, making it ideal for swimming with children. Here, you can rent mattresses and umbrellas—a rare convenience in Phuket nowadays.

The Calypso condominium offers a choice of one- and two-bedroom apartments ranging from 33 sq.m. up to luxury units of 73 sq.m. In total, the complex has 46 apartments. Комплекс Кокянг расположен на юге острова Пхукет, в центре популярного района Най-Харна, всего лишь в 5 минутах езды от пляжа ив 150 метрах от ресторанов и кафе. Комплекс состоит из 25 вилл в двух идентичных проектах, расположенных в 100 метрах друг от друга. Оба проекта находятся под круглосуточной охраной. Виллы с 2 и 3 спальнями спроектированы буквой L из панорамных окон комнат открывается вид на бассейн. Все виллы прекрасно декорированы и комфортны для проживания. Вилла с 3 спальнями состоит из двух здании. В первом размещена просторная гостиная, которая объединена с кухней и две спальни, с приватными ванными комнатами. Во втором - спальня с отдельной ванной комнатой. При выходе из виллы Вы окажетесь на террасе рядом с личным бассейном. Возле каждой виллы есть парковочное место под крышей.

Магазины, рестораны и массаж, находятся в шаговой доступности.

Один из лучших пляжей - Найхарн находится в 3 километрах от проекта. Пляж пользуется популярностью у семей с детьми и экспатов, по этому здесь вы не встретите большое скопление туристов. В двух шагах от пляжа есть пресноводное озеро и смотровая площадка с ветряными мельницами. Пляж Най Харн пользуется популярностью у семей с детьми, а также у зимовщиков и долгожителей острова. Отпуск здесь проводить комфортно, т.к. рядом множество ресторанов как европейской. так и национальной тайской кухни. Здесь же есть офисы с арендой транспорта и экскурсионными услугами. Для длительного проживания на Найхарне комфортно жить семьям с детьми - рядом расположены международные и тайские детские сады, интернациональные и русская школы. Путь от Найхарна до популярного детского игрового комплекс «Раваи парк» займет 5 минут на авто или байке.

Также Найхарн часто выбирают для йога-туров или спортивных кемпингов. На Найхарне и в соседнем с ним районе Раваи сосредоточены спортивные залы, специализированные ринги для занятий тайским боксом и площадки для воркаута. В 5 минутах езды находится гипер маркет Макро, супермаркет с европейскими продуктами Villa Market, рыбный рынок. Так же в этом районе сконцентрировано максимальное количество школ и детских садов.

Комплекс идеально подходит абсолютно всем категориям туристов. Отличное место для отдыха с детьми и для пар и компаний любого возраста. Виллы в проекте доступны, как для коротких каникул, так и для долгосрочной аренды.

Магазины, рестораны и массаж, находятся в шаговой доступности.

Phureesala complex presents only 5 private villas with their own parking and 24-hour security. Each villa has its own private garden and pool. The complex was built near Bangtao Beach in 2000 and is still a favourite place for expats and guests of Phuket. The spacious, fully furnished villas are tastefully decorated to give guests a true Southeast Asian experience.

On the territory of the complex there are walking paths and security.

Next to Phureesala is the Laguna Phuket Golf Club, which hosts international class tournaments. Inexperienced golfers can use the services of a personal golf coach. A 10-minute drive from Phureesala is the Boat Avenue shopping complex with a variety of shops, countless restaurants and bars, and Villa Market, a European supermarket. The modern Porto De Phuket shopping complex, with countless restaurants, Tors supermarket, boutiques and food court, is just a short drive away. 3-Bedroom Apartments, with garden view and near the sea in Chom Tawan project, on Bangtao/Laguna beach

The apartments are located on the west coast of Phuket, just 150 meters from the beautiful Bang Tao Beach. Thoughtful design, professional management services, and close proximity to the beach make this place perfect for family vacations or a getaway with friends.

Guests have access to three spacious bedrooms, a living room, and a fully equipped kitchen built to European standards. The living room opens onto a large outdoor terrace, and just a few steps away is the shared swimming pool.

The apartments are located on the west coast of Phuket, just 150 meters from the beautiful Bang Tao Beach. Thoughtful design, professional management services, and close proximity to the beach make this place perfect for family vacations or a getaway with friends.

Guests have access to three spacious bedrooms, a living room, and a fully equipped kitchen built to European standards. The living room opens onto a large outdoor terrace, and just a few steps away is the shared swimming pool.

The complex is only a two-minute drive from the 5-star Laguna resort. Nearby are renowned luxury hotels such as Banyan Tree and Movenpick, as well as the Dream Beach Club. Restaurants, cafes, and clubs are all within walking distance or just a short drive away.

A rarity for Phuket - the first line from the sea! Chom Tawan is a complex of cozy spacious apartments and villas with a beautiful view located 50 meters from Bangtao beach. The apartments consist of 3-storey buildings, the villas are two-storey. In total, the complex has 20 luxurious villas and 24 spacious apartments, made in the same style. Built in Thai tropical style: massive furniture, lots of greenery, trees and winding paths among the palm trees.

On the territory of the project there is a swimming pool with sun loungers, a children's pool, parking. Chom Tawan is a small, well-groomed town with lush walking paths and green lawns between houses. The project is guarded around the clock; the office of the service company is also located here.

The 8 km long Bangtao Beach is within walking distance of the Chom Tawan Project. This beach is home to Phuket's most popular beach clubs such as Xana Beach Club, Dream Beach Club and Catch Club. Next to Chom Tawan is the Laguna Phuket Golf Club, which hosts international tournaments. Inexperienced golfers can use the services of a personal golf coach. Nearby is the Boat Avenue shopping complex with many shops, countless restaurants and bars, and the Villa Market supermarket for European products. The modern Porto De Phuket shopping complex, with countless restaurants, Tors supermarket, boutiques and food court, is just a short walk away. Nearby is the Lemonade Kids Club with a children's room and a pool for children, a hot sauna for adults. The bustling party scene of Patong is a 25-minute drive from the complex. The road from the airport to the complex will take about 30 minutes. This location makes Chom Tawan one of the most desirable and popular residential complexes for both tourists and expats.

The location of the buildings and villas ensures complete privacy, which is why the wealthy guests of the island like to relax here. The large size of the villas attracts large families with children and nannies. And the peculiarity of the layout with private, non-contiguous bedrooms is liked by large campaigns from several families.

One of the most stunning projects in the south of the island.

One of the most stunning projects in the south of the island.

Pandora Residences is a fully furnished luxury apartment complex.

The main feature that makes these apartments truly unique is the breathtaking view from the Pandora Residences terraces. Perched on a hill, the complex rises above the sea and is seamlessly integrated into the landscape, enhancing rather than disrupting the perfect balance created by nature.

The spectacular sea views, communal areas with all the amenities of a cozy boutique hotel, and luxurious interiors make Pandora Residences the ideal choice for exclusive living in Phuket.

Built in 2017, Pandora Residences on Phuket Island offers 14 exclusive, fully furnished two- and three-level luxury/premium apartments ranging from 90 to 300 m², each featuring private outdoor relaxation areas.

Each apartment is designed in an exclusive classic style, thoughtfully detailed down to the smallest element. The kitchen, equipped with modern appliances, flows into a spacious dining area and a living room furnished with comfortable seating. The first floor includes a study or guest bedroom, depending on the apartment you choose. Upstairs, you’ll find two spacious bedrooms, each with its own bathroom. The complex offers all the comforts of a cozy hotel: a swimming pool, 24-hour security, TV, and Wi-Fi. Nestled on a hill surrounded by tropical nature, it is close to the stunning beaches of Nai Harn and Rawai.

Nearby the condominium are popular tourist spots such as Promthep Cape and Chalong Pier, perfect for capturing unique panoramic photos and sunset selfies, as well as the Big Buddha statue and the serene Chalong Temple. For seafood lovers, just a 15-minute walk away is the Sea Gypsy village, home to a daily fish market.

For those who like to stay fit even on vacation, Phuket Fit is an excellent option, offering sauna and gym facilities, along with comprehensive programs for fitness maintenance, detox, or weight loss.

Pandora Residences is a luxury apartment complex with magnificent sea views located in the south of Phuket Island. The Pandora Residences project was created for those who value true comfort and luxury in detail. The residential complex includes 14 two- and three-storey apartments with elegant interiors and a well-groomed common area with a swimming pool and sun terrace. Situated on a hill surrounded by unspoiled nature, you can enjoy beautiful views of the Andaman Sea and mountains fringed with tropical vegetation. The service in the residential complex is comparable to the conveniences of a small hotel, which allows residents to clear their minds and immerse themselves in an atmosphere of peace and comfort. On the territory there is a large swimming pool, round-the-clock security.

The villa is located on Rawai Beach - this beach is not very comfortable for swimming due to frequent low tides. But along the beach there is a picturesque promenade with fish restaurants, and in its eastern part there is a sea gypsy market, famous in Phuket, where fresh and live seafood is sold. The nearest bathing beach - Nai Harn is a 10-minute drive from the villa. The beach is popular with families with children and expats, so you will not find a large crowd of tourists here. It is comfortable to spend your holiday here, because Nearby there are many restaurants like European, and national Thai cuisine. There are also offices with transport rental and excursion services.

There is an international school just a stone's throw from the complex. Also, within a radius of 5-10 kilometres there are Russian and Thai kindergartens, international and Russian schools.

In the Rawai district and in the neighbouring Naiharn district, there are gyms, specialized rings for Thai boxing and workout grounds. In 7-10 minutes drive there is a hyper market Makro, a supermarket with European products Villa Market, a fish market. Super grocery stores: Tesco Lotus, Macro, Villa Market, seafood market in Rawai, numerous convenience stores (7-Eleven Super Cheap, Family Mart).

The luxurious complex will not leave indifferent the most demanding client in love with the southern part of Phuket. This complex is ideal for both permanent residence and for vacations or wintering.

The master suite features a king-size bed, direct access to the terrace and a spacious ensuite bathroom with a signature circular soaking tub, double vanity and separate walk-in shower. The second bedroom offers twin beds and an ensuite bathroom, while the third bedroom features a comfortable double bed and access to a third modern bathroom. The layout comfortably accommodates up to six guests.

As part of the Angsana Oceanview community, guests enjoy access to beautifully landscaped surroundings, communal facilities, 24-hour security, dedicated residential reception and secure parking. A complimentary Laguna shuttle and scenic lagoon boat service provide convenient connections to Bang Tao Beach, the Laguna golf course and Porto de Phuket.

Professionally managed to high residential standards, the residence also provides high-speed Wi-Fi and utilities for normal residential usage.

Located within Laguna Phuket, the property offers an ideal balance between privacy and convenience, with easy access to Bang Tao Beach, restaurants, beach clubs, golf, wellness facilities and the lifestyle destinations of Bang Tao and Cherngtalay.

This exceptional 3-bedroom residence is an ideal choice for families or groups looking for a spacious private retreat with a swimming pool, generous outdoor living space and access to one of Phuket’s most established resort destinations.

description:
3-Bedroom Apartments, with sea view in The Heights project, on Kata beach

These spacious apartments with high ceilings feel more like a villa than a typical apartment, thanks to a separate double entrance, vast space, lush greenery surrounding the building, and excellent soundproofing. You won’t hear any neighbors here—only the sea and the sound of the waves.

The 410 sq.m penthouse features three impressive bedrooms, four bathrooms, a large living room, a fully equipped kitchen, and a private 15-meter landscaped pool. From the living room, you can enjoy unforgettable views of the pool stretching

These spacious apartments with high ceilings feel more like a villa than a typical apartment, thanks to a separate double entrance, vast space, lush greenery surrounding the building, and excellent soundproofing. You won’t hear any neighbors here—only the sea and the sound of the waves.

The 410 sq.m penthouse features three impressive bedrooms, four bathrooms, a large living room, a fully equipped kitchen, and a private 15-meter landscaped pool. From the living room, you can enjoy unforgettable views of the pool stretching out to the Andaman Sea.

The huge open-plan living area combines the kitchen and dining space. The kitchen includes an electric stove, extractor hood, toaster, kettle, microwave, refrigerator, and a full set of various dishes and kitchen utensils. A convenient breakfast bar separates the kitchen from the living room. The dining area features a table with seating for six.

Sliding glass doors in the master bedroom and living room open onto a large terrace, where you can sit outdoors during the rain or find shade from the direct sun during the day.

The unique project The Heights by renowned designer Hans Brouwer was built in 2009. Simple functional spaces and quality natural materials represent the best combination of east and west. The complex located on a hill offers a magnificent panoramic view of the Kata Bay, and in order to enjoy it to the fullest, the designer has created huge terraces with transparent railings. The project represents 51 residences, which are terraced one above the other on a hill, each of the residences has a separate entrance and a magnificent sea view. There are two types of residences in the project: 2-bedroom apartments with spacious terraces of 219m2 and duplex penthouses with 3 bedrooms, with private pools and the best sea views of 410m2. The project looks very modern, high ceilings, light colours, huge panoramic windows and straight lines. The Heights Phuket has won the Thailand Property Awards for Best Condominium in Thailand and Phuket.

The Heights offers its guests and owners the complete infrastructure of a good hotel: communal swimming pool, equipped fitness centre, sauna, covered parking. The complex is guarded round the clock and has a service company on the territory, which instantly solves all household issues of its residents and guests.

The huge advantage of the project over the rest is the stunning views of the sea and sunsets, plus its ideal location! Very close - in a straight line about 300 meters, along the road - a little further, but no more than 3-5 minutes by car, there are two beaches - the incredibly beautiful Kata Noi beach with the purest turquoise water and white sand, and the noisy, crowded Kata beach. In addition, the entire tourist infrastructure, everything you can wish for on holiday - massage, excursion bureaus, restaurants and cafés, bars, shops in a huge variety are within walking distance. Kata is one of the most popular tourist beaches, but there are no nightclubs and almost no bars, so it is quite calm at night. This area is often chosen for families. And if you go up the road from the apartment, then there you will find a viewpoint overlooking Kata Noi, Kata and Karon, and this road itself leads to Nai Harn Beach. The famous Mom Trees restaurant is located within walking distance.

The residences are very spacious and are ideal not only for relaxation, but also for long-term living. The Heights is chosen by those for whom look and space are very important, as well as lovers of modern style. Renting an apartment here will save you enormous money if you compare the cost of renting with living in hotels of a similar level.

Kata is a popular beach area with strong tourist demand, restaurants, viewpoints and convenient access to the south of Phuket. Properties here are attractive for holiday rentals.

The upper floor houses the living room, kitchen, and dining area. Floor-to-ceiling panoramic windows offer stunning views of the sea and breathtaking sunsets in the evenings.

The unique project The Heights by renowned designer Hans Brouwer was built in 2009. Simple functional spaces and quality natural materials represent the best combination of east and west. The complex located on a hill offers a magnificent panoramic view of the Kata Bay, and in order to enjoy it to the fullest, the designer has created huge terraces with transparent railings. The project represents 51 residences, which are terraced one above the other on a hill, each of the residences has a separate entrance and a magnificent sea view. There are two types of residences in the project: 2-bedroom apartments with spacious terraces of 219m2 and duplex penthouses with 3 bedrooms, with private pools and the best sea views of 410m2. The project looks very modern, high ceilings, light colours, huge panoramic windows and straight lines. The Heights Phuket has won the Thailand Property Awards for Best Condominium in Thailand and Phuket.

The Heights offers its guests and owners the complete infrastructure of a good hotel: communal swimming pool, equipped fitness centre, sauna, covered parking. The complex is guarded round the clock and has a service company on the territory, which instantly solves all household issues of its residents and guests.

The huge advantage of the project over the rest is the stunning views of the sea and sunsets, plus its ideal location! Very close - in a straight line about 300 meters, along the road - a little further, but no more than 3-5 minutes by car, there are two beaches - the incredibly beautiful Kata Noi beach with the purest turquoise water and white sand, and the noisy, crowded Kata beach. In addition, the entire tourist infrastructure, everything you can wish for on holiday - massage, excursion bureaus, restaurants and cafés, bars, shops in a huge variety are within walking distance. Kata is one of the most popular tourist beaches, but there are no nightclubs and almost no bars, so it is quite calm at night. This area is often chosen for families. And if you go up the road from the apartment, then there you will find a viewpoint overlooking Kata Noi, Kata and Karon, and this road itself leads to Nai Harn Beach. The famous Mom Trees restaurant is located within walking distance.

The residences are very spacious and are ideal not only for relaxation, but also for long-term living. The Heights is chosen by those for whom look and space are very important, as well as lovers of modern style. Renting an apartment here will save you enormous money if you compare the cost of renting with living in hotels of a similar level.

Especially since we’ve already found the perfect place for you where all these luxuries come together in one spot. Located in the bay of Chalong, this complex offers cozy and charming homes with one, two, or three bedrooms—ideal for solo travelers, large groups, families with children, or couples in love. The one- and two-bedroom houses don’t have sea views, but they are nestled amidst a lush sea of blooming greenery. All 35 houses boast unique styles both inside and out, and are maintained in impeccable condition. Surrounding the complex is a wealth of restaurants serving cuisine from around the world, several large shopping centers, grocery and wine stores, spa salons, travel agencies, clinics, and car and motorcycle rentals. In short, everything you could possibly need!

Until recently, not everyone could afford to rent a villa in Phuket’s most prestigious area called Laguna, which is an exceptional integration of several 5-star hotels and residential complexes, complete with all the elite neighborhood amenities such as a golf course, tennis courts, spa salons, beach clubs, shops, restaurants and bars, a free shuttle service, and even river trams that will take you to any of the hotels within the Laguna complex at no cost. The new residential development, Laguna Park, immediately became the most attractive rental option upon its opening, offering Phuket visitors a wide selection of affordable housing.

The residential area is set in a picturesque and completely safe environment, with its main advantage being within walking distance to the 8-kilometer-long Bang Tao Beach. The common areas are fully equipped for comfortable living – a playground for the youngest residents, a barbecue relaxation zone for their parents, a swimming pool, green lawns and paths for walking and cycling, and 24-hour security.

The townhouse in Laguna Park is an ideal home for a small family, featuring 2 bedrooms, a hybrid space on the third floor, 4 bathrooms, and private parking. On the ground floor, you’ll find the living room and a fully equipped kitchen. The second floor houses two spacious bedrooms, each with its own bathroom. The top floor offers a third room bathed in natural light thanks to floor-to-ceiling glass windows. Also on the third floor is a spacious open terrace, perfect for unwinding after a day full of adventures.

The location of the complex is simply perfect – within walking distance to all the area’s infrastructure: restaurants, bars, trendy clothing stores, massage salons, and the Villa Market supermarket.

Laguna Park is a large residential project within the Laguna Phuket Resort. The Laguna Park project has 2 types of properties on its territory: townhouses with 2 or 3 bedrooms and large villas with 4 or 5 bedrooms. In total, there are about 200 private houses in the Art Nouveau style on the territory of the complex, all of them are three-storey, made in the same modern style and grey colours. There is a parking lot in front of each house, corner townhouses and all villas have their own small plot of land. Some villas have a private pool on the ground or on the third floor terrace. Launa Park is located in the heart of Laguna Phuket Resort. Laguna Park guests and residents can take advantage of the entire infrastructure of the huge Laguna Phuket Resort, receiving privileges in the form of discounts at the restaurants, spas and boutiques of the resort.

On the territory of Laguna Park there is a communal swimming pool with sun loungers, showers and toilets, walking paths. For children there is a small playground where you can just play and spend time. A free shuttle bus runs regularly from the complex to the beach and back. While resting at the Laguna Park hotel, you do not need to rent transport - by shuttle you can get to the beach, restaurants, shops, the main building. This is especially convenient for families with small children.

Laguna Park is a 15-minute walk to Bangtao Beach. This beach is where Phuket's most popular beach clubs are located, such as Xana Beach Club, Dream Beach Club and Catch Club. Next to Laguna park is the Laguna Phuket golf club, where international class tournaments are held. Inexperienced golfers can use the services of a personal golf coach. A 5-minute drive from Laguna Park is the Boat Avenue shopping complex with a variety of shops, countless restaurants and bars, and a European supermarket Villa Market. The modern Porto De Phuket shopping complex, with countless restaurants, Tors supermarket, boutiques and food court, is just a short drive away. Nearby is the Lemonade Kids Club with a children's room and a pool for children, a hot sauna for adults. The bustling party scene of Patong is a 30-minute drive from the complex. The road from the airport to the complex will take about 25 minutes.

Laguna Park is quite affordable housing, but it is located in one of the most prestigious areas of Phuket with a developed infrastructure, so all categories of tourists like to rest here. The townhouse format is ideal for those who do not want to overpay for a villa with a pool, and at the same time want to relax in their own house on the ground. Whether you rent or purchase a property in Laguna Phuket, you and your home acquire the style, lifestyle and privileges of a resident of the most prestigious Asian resort.

Saiyuan Med Village, a complex located in the south of Phuket, a 10-minute drive from one of the best beaches in Phuket, Naiharn Beach. The construction of the complex was completed in 2010. In a closed area there are several asphalted streets where 63 Mediterranean style villas with 2, 3, 4 and 5 bedrooms, ranging from 120 m2 to 240 m2, are comfortably located. All houses on the outside are made in the same architectural style, but at the same time they have different layouts and designs. The project has villas with a private pool, each house has its own parking.

The complex is under round-the-clock security, on the territory there is an office of the management company, a communal pool and a playground.

The complex is located in an area with a developed tourist infrastructure, close to restaurants, massage parlours, and 24-hour mini-markets. One of the best beaches - Naiharn is a 10-minute drive from the projects. The beach is popular with families with children and expats, so you will not find a large crowd of tourists here. A stone's throw from the beach, there is a freshwater lake and an observation deck with windmills. Nai Harn Beach is popular with families with children, as well as with winterers and long-livers of the island. It is comfortable to spend your vacation here, because Nearby there are many restaurants like European, and national Thai cuisine. There are also offices with transport rental and excursion services. For a long stay on Naiharn, it is comfortable to live for families with children - there are international and Thai kindergartens, international and Russian schools nearby. The way from Naiharn to the popular children's play complex "Rawai Park" will take 5 minutes by car or bike.

Naiharn is also often chosen for yoga tours or sports campings. At Naiharn and in the neighbouring Rawai district, there are gyms, specialized rings for Thai boxing and workout grounds. In 7-10 minutes drive there is a hyper market Makro, a supermarket with European products Villa Market, a fish market.

The complex is ideal for absolutely everyone. Different sizes of villas and pricing policies will allow each category of tourists to spend their holidays in comfort. Especially popular with families with children and expats. Most often it is chosen for long-term residence. The location of the villas ensures privacy and comfort.

Instead of the sound of sirens and car horns, hear the songs of tropical birds and the soothing rush of incoming waves. Breathe in the fresh air and feel the sea breeze gently tickle your skin. Why deny yourself such a pleasure?

Especially since we’ve already found the perfect place for you where all these luxuries come together. Located in the bay of Chalong, this complex offers cozy and charming homes with one, two, or three bedrooms—ideal for solo travelers, large groups, families with children, or couples in love. The one- and two-bedroom houses don’t have sea views, but the buildings are literally immersed in a lush sea of blooming greenery. In contrast, the three-bedroom homes are built right on the shore and feature infinity pools that create an incredible sense of unity with the ocean. All 35 houses are unique in style, both inside and out, and are maintained in impeccable condition. The homes are not clustered together; instead, they are thoughtfully scattered across the grounds, providing a sense of privacy and security. Surrounding the complex are numerous restaurants offering dishes from around the world, several large shopping centers, grocery and wine stores, spa salons, travel agencies, clinics, and car and motorcycle rentals. In short, everything you could possibly need!

All of this makes the complex an enticing choice for your stay in Phuket! Welcome!

Chalong is a sought-after location in Phuket with convenient access to beaches, restaurants, services and tourist infrastructure.

Civetta Villas is a project of six boutique villas located on a serene hillside in the residential area of ​​Nai Harn. The concept of the Civetta project is based on two main ideas: maximising the use of green spaces and saving energy. The hydraulic and electrical systems have been designed and tested by European technicians using parts imported from Europe and of the highest quality. Each villa has three spacious bedrooms, each with its own bathroom. On the ground floor there is one bedroom, on the upper floor there are two. Open plan dining and kitchen area. The fully equipped kitchen has a kitchen island / breakfast bar. There is also a guest toilet and storage room. The living room opens onto the pool terrace and garden. The project is adjacent to the 5-star Mangosteen Resort, which offers special resort rates and use of amenities. It is under 24-hour security and video surveillance.

One of the best beaches - Nai Harn is located 5.5 kilometers from the project. The beach is popular with families with children and expats, so you will not find a large crowd of tourists here. A stone's throw from the beach, there is a freshwater lake and an observation deck with windmills. Nai Harn Beach is popular with families with children, as well as those who prefer to spend winter on the island. It is comfortable to spend your vacation here, because Nearby there are many restaurants like European. and national Thai cuisine. There are also offices with transport rental and excursion services.

Nai Harn is also often chosen for yoga tours or sports campings. In Nai Harn and Rawai have plenty of gyms, Thai boxing camps and workout spots. A 5-minute drive away is a Macro hypermarket, a supermarket with European products Villa Market, a fish market.

It offers 3 bedrooms. The sea is approximately 4,200 m away. The unit is part of Civetta Villas.

Комплекс идеально подходит абсолютно всем категориям туристов. Отличное место для отдыха с детьми и для пар и компаний любого возраста. Виллы в проекте доступны, как для коротких каникул, так и для долгосрочной аренды.

name: Bang Tao — 3-Bedroom Villa, with pool view in Laguna Cove project, on Bangtao/Laguna beach
description:
3-Bedroom Villa, with pool view in Laguna Cove project, on Bangtao/Laguna beach

This stunning villa is located in the very heart of Laguna, with a mesmerizing lake view on one side and a golf course on the other.

This stunning villa is located in the very heart of Laguna, with a mesmerizing lake view on one side and a golf course on the other.

Upon entering the home, you step into a spacious living and dining area. The separate kitchen is fully equipped to European standards and includes a dedicated laundry room. The villa is furnished and outfitted to very high standards. The spacious living room features comfortable sofas, handcrafted natural wood furniture, imported artworks, and a full entertainment system, as well as surround sound with a wireless audio system controlled remotely in the teak-roofed gazebo, complete with a fan and lighting – the perfect spot to spend your time.

The dining area is beautifully situated by panoramic windows overlooking the stunning black-tiled pool, the lake, and the surrounding hills. Around the pool and gazebo, there are covered sun loungers and a large barbecue. The pool, one of the few with black tiles, measures 2.5 x 9.7 meters and runs alongside the dining area.

Upstairs, all three bedrooms are filled with fine details that will make your stay very comfortable from the very first moment, boasting charming appeal through the perfect blend of colors and textures.

The master bedroom features a large bathroom with a spacious walk-in closet, a mirror to enhance visual perception, and views from the custom-made bed of the lagoon that make it hard to get out of bed in the morning.

Guests also have access to additional amenities such as unlimited free shuttle buses between resorts and water ferries within Laguna.

High-speed internet is available throughout the villa. Cable TV includes Russian channels. There is a two-person canoe for leisurely paddling on the lake and two sets of "Taylor Made" golf clubs for your enjoyment.

Laguna Cove is a small residential complex located in the heart of Laguna Phuket Resort. It was built in 2005 and has become a favourite place for wealthy people to live and relax. Guests and residents of Laguna Cove can use the infrastructure of the Laguna Phuket complex, receiving privileges in the form of discounts at the restaurants, spas and boutiques of the resort. The project has on its territory real estate in the form of townhouses with private pools. There are a total of 8 villas in the project, all of them are two-storey, made in the same style and located along the shores of a picturesque lake. Its peculiarity is that this project is in close proximity to the entire infrastructure and the beach.

Laguna Cove is located in the heart of the Laguna. Within walking distance you can reach the beach, shops, restaurants, bars, spas, banks and more. A free shuttle bus runs regularly from the complex to the beach and back. While resting in Laguna Cove, you do not need to rent transport - you can use the shuttle to get to the beach, to restaurants, shops. This is especially convenient for families with small children.

Laguna Cove is a 10-minute walk from Bangtao Beach. This beach is where Phuket's most popular beach clubs are located, such as Xana Beach Club, Dream Beach Club and Catch Club. Next to Laguna Cove is the Laguna Phuket Golf Club, which hosts international tournaments. Inexperienced golfers can use the services of a personal golf coach. A 10-minute walk from the complex is the Boat Avenue shopping complex with many shops, countless restaurants and bars, Villa Market supermarket of European products. The modern Porto De Phuket shopping complex, with countless restaurants, Tors supermarket, boutiques and food court, is just a short drive away. Nearby is the Lemonade Kids Club with a children's room and a pool for children, a hot sauna for adults. The bustling party scene of Patong is a 30-minute drive from the complex. The road from the airport to the complex will take about 25 minutes.

The complex is located in one of the most prestigious areas of Phuket with a developed infrastructure, so wealthy guests of the island like to relax here. Whether you rent or purchase a property in Laguna Phuket, you and your home acquire the style, lifestyle and privileges of a resident of the most prestigious Asian resort.

It offers 3 bedrooms. Total area is 470 m². The sea is approximately 700 m away. The unit is part of Laguna Cove.

If you like the idea of having 2 master bedrooms in a villa, look no further, as this is one of the remarkable features that Shambhala Grand Villa offers. The developers understand that a villa with such a configuration is very attractive to renters, which will significantly contribute to achieving a strong return on investment for its owners.

The concept was created with families in mind. Most of this project features what is known as the Family Collection with 2 bedrooms. Shambhala Grand Villa is a fully family-oriented project with a garden playground where children can also enjoy the outdoors.

Construction of the complex has already begun and is planned to be completed by January 2021 for phase 1 and by April 2021 for phase 2.

The project consists of modern villas completed in 2021, close to the Laguna resort. The architecture is simple and fresh, with a white color palette and many tropical plants and flowers. There are 43 villas in the project. The first phase of the project has been completed and is already waiting for its guests. One-story 2 and 3 bedroom villas with private pools. A special feature of the villas is that each bedroom is located in a separate pavilion. The concept of the project is to provide a relaxing atmosphere and feel at home. The developer has developed a plan for the one-story villas in order to provide you with the complete privacy of your home in Phuket.

There will be a fitness center and a restaurant on the territory. The project is under 24-hour security and video surveillance.

The complex is located within walking distance to the entire infrastructure of the Laguna resort and opposite an amusement park under construction, as well as a 5-minute drive from Bangtao Beach. This beach is where Phuket's most popular beach clubs are located, such as Xana Beach Club, Dream Beach Club and Catch Club. Blue Tree is located nearby - this is a large entertainment complex that includes: the actual lagoon of the water park with various attractions on water and land, several large parking lots, a helipad, a kids club, a fitness area, a shopping center, restaurants and mobile tents with food. Blue tree Phuket Water Park opened its doors in the fall of 2019 in the north of the island, not far from Bangtao Beach. And he is already one of the top attractions in Phuket. The park is suitable for visitors of all ages, especially children. An active day for the whole family is guaranteed! In 2 minutes there is a shopping complex Boat Avenue with many shops, countless restaurants and bars, a supermarket of European products Villa Market. The modern Porto De Phuket shopping complex, with countless restaurants, Tors supermarket, boutiques and food court, is just a short drive away. The road from the airport to the complex will take about 25 minutes.
