This small complex, consisting of eleven villas, is located just a 10-minute drive from Bang Tao Beach and 3 km from the Boat Avenue market square, Villa Market supermarket, and the renowned 5-star Laguna resort.

The design features calm gray and beige tones with wood accents. The pool is finished with unique lava stone tiles showcasing a stunning, vibrant green color. Each villa, with an area of 436 m², has a well-thought-out layout — the ground floor includes an open-plan living room, dining area, and kitchen, a bedroom with an en-suite bathroom and walk-in closet, and a guest toilet. From the living room, you can step out onto the terrace leading to your private pool and beautifully landscaped garden. The second floor houses the master bedroom with an en-suite bathroom, a second bedroom, a family lounge, and an office.

These villas are perfect for both permanent residence and vacation stays.

The Granary Villas is a house and villa project located in Si Sunthon, Phuket and was completed in May 2019. It consists of 11 units and was developed by Wallaya Villas.

The Project is one of its kind gated development of modern looking barn - villas spread among of 4 rai (5,927.96 SQ.M sq.m.) of land in Pasak Area.

Inspired by the architectural design of a barn house in the western countries, the developer has brought this architecture all the way to Thailand, in the heart of Phuket. The property feels just like a modern farmhouse, a compelling way of life for those who yearn for the rural idyll reinterpreted in a crisp, contemporary way combined with a modern take.

The property is built with floor-to-ceiling windows, exposing the environments and welcoming the natural lights. The glass stretches not just vertically but horizontally, making it feel as though you are living in the open air.

The light-filled rooms combined with the high ceilings create spectacular living rooms, dining areas, and even bathrooms. The abundant light these windows let in; the kitchen is bright and cheery in the morning, while the living room glows as the sun sets.

Until recently, not everyone could afford to rent a villa in Phuket’s most prestigious area called Laguna, which is an exceptional integration of several 5-star hotels and residential complexes, complete with all the elite neighborhood amenities such as a golf course, tennis courts, spa salons, beach clubs, shops, restaurants and bars, a free shuttle service, and even river trams that will take you to any of the hotels within the Laguna complex at no cost. The new residential development Laguna Park quickly became the most attractive rental option upon its opening, offering Phuket visitors a wide selection of affordable housing.

The complex is set in a picturesque and completely safe environment, with its main advantage being walking distance to the 8-kilometer-long Bang Tao Beach. The common areas are fully equipped for comfortable living: a playground for the youngest residents, a barbecue relaxation zone for their parents, a swimming pool, green lawns and pathways for walking and cycling, and 24-hour security.

The townhouse in Laguna Park is the perfect home for a small family, featuring 3 bedrooms, 4 bathrooms, private parking, and a generously sized yard. On the ground floor, you’ll find the living room and a fully equipped kitchen. The second floor houses two spacious bedrooms, each with its own bathroom. The top floor boasts a third room bathed in natural light thanks to floor-to-ceiling glass windows. Also on this level is a large open terrace, ideal for unwinding after a day full of adventures.

The location of the complex is simply ideal — within walking distance to all the neighborhood’s amenities: restaurants, bars, trendy clothing stores, massage salons, and the Villa Market supermarket.

Laguna Park is a large residential project within the Laguna Phuket Resort. The Laguna Park project has 2 types of properties on its territory: townhouses with 2 or 3 bedrooms and large villas with 4 or 5 bedrooms. In total, there are about 200 private houses in the Art Nouveau style on the territory of the complex, all of them are three-storey, made in the same modern style and grey colours. There is a parking lot in front of each house, corner townhouses and all villas have their own small plot of land. Some villas have a private pool on the ground or on the third floor terrace. Launa Park is located in the heart of Laguna Phuket Resort. Laguna Park guests and residents can take advantage of the entire infrastructure of the huge Laguna Phuket Resort, receiving privileges in the form of discounts at the restaurants, spas and boutiques of the resort.

On the territory of Laguna Park there is a communal swimming pool with sun loungers, showers and toilets, walking paths. For children there is a small playground where you can just play and spend time. A free shuttle bus runs regularly from the complex to the beach and back. While resting at the Laguna Park hotel, you do not need to rent transport - by shuttle you can get to the beach, restaurants, shops, the main building. This is especially convenient for families with small children.

Laguna Park is a 15-minute walk to Bangtao Beach. This beach is where Phuket's most popular beach clubs are located, such as Xana Beach Club, Dream Beach Club and Catch Club. Next to Laguna park is the Laguna Phuket golf club, where international class tournaments are held. Inexperienced golfers can use the services of a personal golf coach. A 5-minute drive from Laguna Park is the Boat Avenue shopping complex with a variety of shops, countless restaurants and bars, and a European supermarket Villa Market. The modern Porto De Phuket shopping complex, with countless restaurants, Tors supermarket, boutiques and food court, is just a short drive away. Nearby is the Lemonade Kids Club with a children's room and a pool for children, a hot sauna for adults. The bustling party scene of Patong is a 30-minute drive from the complex. The road from the airport to the complex will take about 25 minutes.

Laguna Park is quite affordable housing, but it is located in one of the most prestigious areas of Phuket with a developed infrastructure, so all categories of tourists like to rest here. The townhouse format is ideal for those who do not want to overpay for a villa with a pool, and at the same time want to relax in their own house on the ground. Whether you rent or purchase a property in Laguna Phuket, you and your home acquire the style, lifestyle and privileges of a resident of the most prestigious Asian resort.

It offers 3 bedrooms. Total area is 190 m². The sea is approximately 1,200 m away. The unit is part of Laguna Park .

Over the past 10 years, the construction company has earned a reputation as one of the top designers of luxury real estate in Phuket. The company boasts an impressive portfolio of completed projects, each showcasing a unique style and a clear concept based on four key criteria: ultra-modern design, high quality standards, thoughtful location, and affordable pricing for both villa rentals and sales. This project is no exception.

The complex consists of 16 townhouses, arranged within two three-story buildings. The buildings are constructed on a slight elevation, one behind the other along the shoreline. This design ensures that each villa’s rooftop offers a truly breathtaking view of the turquoise sea. Each townhouse spans three floors. On the first floor, you’ll find a spacious living and dining area that opens onto a large private pool and lawn. The second floor features the master bedroom and a cozy secondary living room, each with its own terrace. This floor also includes a very spacious bathroom equipped with a jacuzzi. The third floor houses two large bedrooms, each with its own bathroom and balcony. The rooftop has been transformed into a massive terrace designed for group relaxation. It includes a sala (pavilion), a large dining table, a barbecue area, and even a small lawn. Don’t forget—the terrace offers stunning ocean views.

Gated complex of 22 luxury beachfront villas on the East Coast. 12 villas in the complex are located on the first line of Rawai Beach. Outdoor terraces with dining groups and a sun lounger area are located right at the seaside. The complex is designed on two levels, the villas are located in such a way that from the panoramic windows of each, a direct view of the sea opens. The descent to the lower level from the parking lot is equipped with a lift. Villas with 3 and 4 bedrooms ranging from 420 sqm with private salt-purified pools. On the ground floor there is a spacious living room, a modern kitchen equipped with all the necessary appliances combined with a dining area, through the panoramic windows-doors of the living room, overlooking the pool and garden, the floor of the lower floor is made of natural stone. On the second floor there are two or three bedrooms with private bathrooms with natural marble fittings and Kohler and Hafaele fixtures. The stairs between the three floors, the floor in the bedrooms and the walk-in closets are made of natural teak. On the third floor there is another bedroom with a huge terrace and stunning sea and mountain views.

The villa is located on Rawai Beach - this beach is not very comfortable for swimming due to frequent low tides. But along the beach there is a picturesque promenade with fish restaurants, and in its eastern part there is a sea gypsy market, famous in Phuket, where fresh and live seafood is sold. The nearest bathing beach - Nai Harn is a 10-minute drive from the villa. The beach is popular with families with children and expats, so you will not find a large crowd of tourists here. It is comfortable to spend your vacation here, because Nearby there are many restaurants like European. and national Thai cuisine. There are also offices with transport rental and excursion services.

There is an international school just a stone's throw from the complex. Also within a radius of 5-10 kilometers there are Russian and Thai kindergartens, international and Russian schools.

In the Rawai district and in the neighbouring Nai Harn district, there are gyms, specialised rings for Thai boxing and workout grounds. In 7-10 minutes drive there is a hyper market Makro, a supermarket with European products Villa Market, a fish market. Super grocery stores: Tesco Lotus, Macro, Villa Market, seafood market in Rawai, a large number of convenience stores (7 Eleven Super Cheap, Family Mart).

The luxurious Eva Beach complex will not leave indifferent the most demanding client in love with the southern part of Phuket. This complex is ideal for both permanent residence and for vacations or wintering.

Guests and residents of Angsana Villas Resort can enjoy the entire infrastructure of the huge Laguna Phuket Resort, receiving privileges in the form of discounts in restaurants, spas and boutiques of the resort. The Angsana Villas Resort Phuket project has 4 types of properties on its territory: residences, duplexes, townhouses and apartments. Residences and duplexes have private pools. In total, the hotel has 151 villas, all of them are two-storey, made in the same style and located along the shores of picturesque lakes. The windows of the houses and terraces offer magnificent views of the lagoon. the townhouses surround the landscaped swimming pool in a semicircle. A feature of the project is that the villas are not fenced off, which gives it a special charm and looks like American suburban villages.

Property owners and their guests can use the gym free of charge, as well as additional paid classes such as Thai boxing, yoga, tai chi, Pilates and more. There is a kids club for children, where you can just play and spend time, or sign up for daily activities such as modeling, painting, making papier-mâché, cooking school, dancing, boxing and much more. A free shuttle bus runs regularly from the complex to the beach and back. This is especially convenient for families with small children. The restaurant offers in-villa or BBQ catering.

The modern Porto De Phuket shopping complex, with countless restaurants, Tors supermarket, boutiques and food court, is just a short drive away. Nearby is the Lemonade Kids Club with a children's room and a pool for children, a hot sauna for adults. The bustling party scene of Patong is a 30-minute drive from the complex. The road from the airport to the complex will take about 25 minutes.

The hotel is located in one of the most prestigious areas of Phuket with a developed infrastructure, so wealthy guests of the island like to relax here. In the vicinity of the villas there are restaurants, cafes with Thai cuisine, grocery stores, pharmacies, etc.

Комплекс Кокянг расположен на юге острова Пхукет, в центре популярного района Най-Харна, всего лишь в 5 минутах езды от пляжа ив 150 метрах от ресторанов и кафе. Комплекс состоит из 25 вилл в двух идентичных проектах, расположенных в 100 метрах друг от друга. Оба проекта находятся под круглосуточной охраной. Виллы с 2 и 3 спальнями спроектированы буквой L из панорамных окон комнат открывается вид на бассейн. Все виллы прекрасно декорированы и комфортны для проживания. Вилла с 3 спальнями состоит из двух здании. В первом размещена просторная гостиная, которая объединена с кухней и две спальни, с приватными ванными комнатами. Во втором - спальня с отдельной ванной комнатой. При выходе из виллы Вы окажетесь на террасе рядом с личным бассейном. Возле каждой виллы есть парковочное место под крышей.

Магазины, рестораны и массаж, находятся в шаговой доступности.

Один из лучших пляжей - Найхарн находится в 3 километрах от проекта. Пляж пользуется популярностью у семей с детьми и экспатов, по этому здесь вы не встретите большое скопление туристов. В двух шагах от пляжа есть пресноводное озеро и смотровая площадка с ветряными мельницами. Пляж Най Харн пользуется популярностью у семей с детьми, а также у зимовщиков и долгожителей острова. Отпуск здесь проводить комфортно, т.к. рядом множество ресторанов как европейской. так и национальной тайской кухни. Здесь же есть офисы с арендой транспорта и экскурсионными услугами. Для длительного проживания на Найхарне комфортно жить семьям с детьми - рядом расположены международные и тайские детские сады, интернациональные и русская школы. Путь от Найхарна до популярного детского игрового комплекс «Раваи парк» займет 5 минут на авто или байке.

Также Найхарн часто выбирают для йога-туров или спортивных кемпингов. На Найхарне и в соседнем с ним районе Раваи сосредоточены спортивные залы, специализированные ринги для занятий тайским боксом и площадки для воркаута. В 5 минутах езды находится гипер маркет Макро, супермаркет с европейскими продуктами Villa Market, рыбный рынок. Так же в этом районе сконцентрировано максимальное количество школ и детских садов.

Комплекс идеально подходит абсолютно всем категориям туристов. Отличное место для отдыха с детьми и для пар и компаний любого возраста. Виллы в проекте доступны, как для коротких каникул, так и для долгосрочной аренды.

It offers 4 bedrooms. Total area is 505 m². The sea is approximately 2,800 m away. The unit is part of Kokyang Estate.

Laguna Fairway is a small residential complex located in Laguna Phuket. Laguna Fairway was built in 2005 and has become a favourite place for wealthy people to live and relax. Guests and residents of Laguna Fairway can use the infrastructure of the Laguna Phuket complex, receiving privileges in the form of discounts at the restaurants, spas and boutiques of the resort. The modern Porto De Phuket shopping complex, with countless restaurants, Tors supermarket, boutiques and food court, is just a short drive away. Nearby is the Lemonade Kids Club with a children's room and a pool for children, a hot sauna for adults. The bustling party scene of Patong is a 30-minute drive from the complex. The road from the airport to the complex will take about 25 minutes.

The complex is located in one of the most prestigious areas of Phuket with a developed infrastructure, so wealthy guests of the island like to relax here. Whether you rent or buy a property in Laguna Phuket, you and your home are acquiring the style, lifestyle and privileges of a resident of the most prestigious Asian resort.

The villa is only a few minutes’ drive from the beautiful Nai Harn, Kata, and Karon beaches, and about 20 minutes from Phuket town center and major shopping malls.

The complex is located in the south of Phuket, just a few minutes from the Rawai promenade, within walking distance from cafes, restaurants and massage parlors. The complex consists of 18 detached villas, each with a private pool, located on a gentle slope among beautiful tropical gardens overlooking Rawai Beach and other outlying islands. The villa is designed in a modern style. The complex has several types of villas with 2, 3 bedrooms - one-storey. Fully equipped kitchen combined with dining area and living room, all bedrooms are isolated, with private bathrooms, parking is available near each villa. Villas with 4 and 5 bedrooms, two-storey, with an area of ​​430 m2, The master bedroom of the villa offers panoramic views of the pool, garden and the entire complex. All villas are isolated from each other with private bathrooms. Private pool 65 sqm equipped with sun loungers. An exotic garden with Thai sala and an outdoor dining area on the terrace will create additional relaxing comfort.

All rooms are technically equipped, equipped with air conditioning, satellite TV and wireless Internet. The western style kitchen is equipped with all the necessary household appliances and utensils, combined with a dining area. There is a washing machine in the utility room. Covered parking is available near each villa.

The complex is located in the centre of the tourist infrastructure of the Rawai region, just a few steps from the famous Rawai embankment. Rawai is not a very comfortable beach for swimming due to the frequent low tide. But along the beach there is a picturesque promenade with fish restaurants, and in its eastern part there is a sea gypsy market, famous in Phuket, where fresh and live seafood is sold. The nearest bathing beach - Nai Harn is a 10-minute drive from the villa. The beach is popular with families with children and expats, so you will not find a large crowd of tourists here. It is comfortable to spend your vacation here, because Nearby there are many restaurants of both European and national Thai cuisine. There are also offices with transport rental and excursion services.

There is an international school within a few minutes drive from the complex. Also, within a radius of 5-10 kilometres there are Russian and Thai kindergartens, international and Russian schools. In the Rawai district and in the neighbouring Naiharn district, there are gyms, specialized rings for Thai boxing and workout grounds. The complex is perfect for any category of tourists; it will be comfortable for families with children, companies and couples of different ages. The villas are suitable for both long and short vacations.

On a vast plot stands a villa with 4 bedrooms, a living room, and a dining area. The villa is built on a single level, and each bedroom opens directly onto a 10-meter pool with a jacuzzi. Sai Taan is one of the largest residences in Phuket. The project consists of 48 luxury Balinese style villas with red tile roofs, ranging from 450 m2, each with 3 to 5 bedrooms. The entire project is executed in the same style, the typical layout of the villa is an L-shaped main building, which houses a living room, a kitchen, several separate bedrooms with their own bathrooms and a maid's room. The villas are fenced off from each other and are completely private. The project is literally surrounded by tropical greenery and flowers.

The Sai Taan project is a small well-groomed town with paths for walks immersed in greenery and green lawns between houses. The project is guarded around the clock, the office of the service company is also located here.

The 8 km long Bangtao Beach is within walking distance of the Sai Taan Project. This beach is home to Phuket's most popular beach clubs such as Xana Beach Club, Dream Beach Club and Catch Club. Next to Sai Taan is the Laguna Phuket Golf Club, which hosts international tournaments. Inexperienced golfers can use the services of a personal golf coach. Just a few steps from Sai Taan Villas - Boat Avenue shopping complex with many shops, countless restaurants and bars, Villa Market supermarket of European products. The modern Porto De Phuket shopping complex, with countless restaurants, Tors supermarket, boutiques and food court, is just a short walk away. Nearby is the Lemonade Kids Club with a children's room and a pool for children, a hot sauna for adults. The bustling party scene of Patong is a 25-minute drive from the complex. The road from the airport to the complex will take about 30 minutes. This location makes Sai Taan one of the most desirable and popular residential developments among tourists and expats alike.

The location of the buildings and villas ensures complete privacy, which is why the wealthy guests of the island like to relax here. Until recently, not everyone could afford to rent a villa in Phuket’s most prestigious area called Laguna, which is an exceptional integration of several 5-star hotels and residential complexes, complete with all the elite neighborhood amenities such as a golf course, tennis courts, spa salons, beach clubs, shops, restaurants and bars, a free shuttle service, and even river trams that will take you to any of the hotels within the Laguna complex at no cost. The new residential development, Laguna Park, immediately became the most attractive rental option upon its opening, offering Phuket visitors a wide selection of affordable housing.

The residential estate is set in a picturesque and completely safe environment, with its main advantage being within walking distance to the 8-kilometer-long Bang Tao Beach. The common areas are fully equipped for comfortable living — a playground for the youngest residents, a barbecue relaxation zone for their parents, a swimming pool, green lawns and paths for walking and cycling, and 24-hour security.

This four-bedroom villa is perfect for a large family. The ground floor features a spacious living room, kitchen, and a guest bedroom. Upstairs, there is a large master bedroom with a walk-in closet and another guest bedroom. On the top floor, you’ll find an additional bedroom and a large rooftop lounge area.

The location of the complex is simply ideal — within walking distance to all the neighborhood’s amenities: restaurants, bars, trendy clothing stores, massage salons, and the Villa Market supermarket.

Laguna Park is a large residential project within the Laguna Phuket Resort. The Laguna Park project has 2 types of properties on its territory: townhouses with 2 or 3 bedrooms and large villas with 4 or 5 bedrooms. In total, there are about 200 private houses in the Art Nouveau style on the territory of the complex, all of them are three-storey, made in the same modern style and grey colours. There is a parking lot in front of each house, corner townhouses and all villas have their own small plot of land. Some villas have a private pool on the ground or on the third floor terrace. Launa Park is located in the heart of Laguna Phuket Resort. Laguna Park guests and residents can take advantage of the entire infrastructure of the huge Laguna Phuket Resort, receiving privileges in the form of discounts at the restaurants, spas and boutiques of the resort.

On the territory of Laguna Park there is a communal swimming pool with sun loungers, showers and toilets, walking paths. For children there is a small playground where you can just play and spend time. A free shuttle bus runs regularly from the complex to the beach and back. While resting at the Laguna Park hotel, you do not need to rent transport - by shuttle you can get to the beach, restaurants, shops, the main building. This is especially convenient for families with small children.

Laguna Park is a 15-minute walk to Bangtao Beach. This beach is where Phuket's most popular beach clubs are located, such as Xana Beach Club, Dream Beach Club and Catch Club. Next to Laguna park is the Laguna Phuket golf club, where international class tournaments are held. Inexperienced golfers can use the services of a personal golf coach. A 5-minute drive from Laguna Park is the Boat Avenue shopping complex with a variety of shops, countless restaurants and bars, and a European supermarket Villa Market. The modern Porto De Phuket shopping complex, with countless restaurants, Tors supermarket, boutiques and food court, is just a short drive away. Nearby is the Lemonade Kids Club with a children's room and a pool for children, a hot sauna for adults. The bustling party scene of Patong is a 30-minute drive from the complex. The road from the airport to the complex will take about 25 minutes.

Laguna Park is quite affordable housing, but it is located in one of the most prestigious areas of Phuket with a developed infrastructure, so all categories of tourists like to rest here. The townhouse format is ideal for those who do not want to overpay for a villa with a pool, and at the same time want to relax in their own house on the ground. Whether you rent or purchase a property in Laguna Phuket, you and your home acquire the style, lifestyle and privileges of a resident of the most prestigious Asian resort.

Spacious living areas offer a stylish setting to relax or entertain. The indoor living room with floor-to-ceiling windows can accommodate 10 people around the dining table, whilst the sofa area is ideal for lounging back to watch the 65” smart TV. The villa has a NETFLIX account linked up and there is free Wi-Fi throughout the entire house.

The focal point of the villa is the vast outside covered terrace which overlooks the lush garden and the ocean. A modern style dining table can seat 10 people, and means most meals will be enjoyed ‘al fresco’. A separate lounge area gives you the chance to sit back and relax whilst you watch the sun go down. The swimming pool is located on the terrace and is surrounded by sun loungers.

Two master bedrooms with ensuite bathrooms are located at the front of the house and with floor-to-ceiling windows it means a stunning view straight out to the ocean from the comfort of your bed. Two further bedrooms, both with en suite, are set back from the garden and equipped with king-size beds and beautifully decorated with the images of the Scandinavian archipelagos.

The kids’ room comes with twin beds with sliding beds underneath, which turn into 4 single beds, allowing for a sleepover experience. This room is also equipped with a TV and a PlayStation (upon request), where the kids can retreat to when the sun has gone down. An extra study room with a fold-away double bed means that Villa Sand can comfortably host up to 10 adults or 8 adults and 6 children. The extra room is also a perfect addition for any family wishing to bring a nanny with them. All rooms have air-conditioning and ceiling fans.

The well-maintained garden separates the house from the beach. Four Barringtonia Asiatica trees in the center provide some welcome shade and also a seating area beneath them. There is space to set up a football pitch or badminton court for everyone to enjoy some afternoon activities, or head down to the beach before the sunset for a game of boule. There are also yoga mats available for those who love a sun salutation and meditation early in the morning. A boathouse located under the garden houses a kayak, windsurf board, and boogie boards which are free to use for all guests.

A Western kitchen includes a fridge/freezer, gas hob, oven, microwave, coffee machine, toaster, and kettle. The kitchen is fully equipped for our guests, and a Tesco Lotus supermarket is located only a 5-minute drive from the villa.

We recommend our guests enjoy the local delights from the nearby restaurants within a 5-minute walk from the villa or take a stroll down the beach to ‘Baba Beach Club’ which serves a wide range of international cuisine from sushi to pizza. If you prefer to enjoy your meals in the comfort of the villa, we have all the restaurant menus available, simply order through our staff and the food will be delivered to your door.

Our two friendly full-time staff are there to make your stay as comfortable as possible. Our lovely maid will help with the daily cleaning, setting up and clearing the table before and after mealtimes, laundry, and general housekeeping, whilst the handyman is there to assist with gardening, pool maintenance, and any general problems that may arise during your stay. Additionally, our concierge manager will be here to get you settled and is only a phone call away during your stay.

This cozy 36 sq.m studio successfully accommodates a double bed, bedside tables, a wardrobe, a fold-out sofa with a lounge area, a fully equipped kitchen, and a dining zone. The apartment's interior is designed in soft, light tones. Clever design solutions have made it possible to create a functional space even in the smallest apartments. This cozy 36 sq.m studio successfully accommodates a double bed, bedside tables, a wardrobe, a fold-out sofa with a lounge area, a fully equipped kitchen, and a dining zone. The Title Nai Yang is a modern resort complex, which consists of seven buildings of 6 and 7 floors and has 472 apartments: studios 36-39m2, one-bedroom apartments with an area of ​​46m2 or two bedrooms, the territory of the complex itself is fenced and is under 24-hour video surveillance and security ... The concept of the project and design is somewhat unusual for Thailand, the complex is decorated with red brick, and it looks more like a medieval castle than a modern Asian condominium. The apartments have a comfortable layout, in light grey and blue colours. The common area is a beautiful, well-groomed recreation park, a river flows along the buildings, which gives the project a certain charm and beauty of the fusion of modern urban architecture with nature.

The complex has its own restaurant, which serves breakfast, lunch and dinner a-la carte. Each building has access to a communal pool and well-kept garden. 5 swimming pools in each building are located on the 1st floor, and the sixth is on the roof of one of the buildings. There is a recreation area on the same roof. The complex offers a free gym, two saunas, a reception, a play area for children in the form of a pirate ship. Parking for 240 cars is organized on the south side of the building and is separated by green spaces and a fence.

The complex blends in perfectly with the tropical environment, and walking to the beach is a real pleasure. Just 5 minutes, and you will find yourself on one of the most stunning beaches in Phuket - Nai Yang. A small, cosy beach with a length of just under 3 kilometres, the water area of ​​which is protected by coral reefs, will allow you to enjoy swimming in the sea all year round, regardless of the season. Since 1986, this beach has been part of the Sirinath National Park Marine Park and all motor sports are prohibited on it. There is a large selection of restaurants, bars and cafés along the beach. The Title project itself separates the famous 5 * hotel The Slate from the beach with excellent gourmet restaurants. A five-minute walk is a local grocery market and mini markets.

The proximity to the sea and low prices make this project one of the most attractive on the island. And the peculiarity of the Nai Yang beach, on which there are never waves, even in low season, makes the project popular all year round. The entrance to the water is very shallow, so the beach is loved by families with small children. The low cost of apartments, both for rent and for purchase, makes the project accessible to everyone.

Nai Yang is a sought-after location in Phuket with convenient access to beaches, restaurants, services and tourist infrastructure.

A new project just 250 meters from the stunning Nai Yang Beach, a few minutes’ drive from the airport, surrounded by a national park. Its proximity to the sea and affordable prices make this development one of the most attractive on the island.

A new project just 250 meters from the stunning Nai Yang Beach, a few minutes’ drive from the airport, surrounded by a national park. Its proximity to the sea and affordable prices make this development one of the most attractive on the island.

The modern complex consists of seven buildings, each 6 to 7 stories high, featuring 472 one- and two-bedroom apartments. The entire complex is gated and secured with 24-hour video surveillance and security personnel.

Each building has direct access to a shared swimming pool and well-maintained gardens. Five pools are located on the first-floor level of each building, while the sixth pool is on the rooftop of one of the buildings, which also features a relaxation area. Residents enjoy complimentary access to a gym, two saunas, a reception area, and a children’s play zone. Parking for 240 cars is arranged on the south side of the complex, separated by greenery and fencing.

The interior of each apartment is designed in soft, light tones. Clever design solutions create a spacious feel even in the smallest units. A cozy 36 sqm studio smartly accommodates a double bed, bedside tables, a wardrobe, a fold-out sofa with a lounge area, a fully equipped kitchen, and a dining space. A subtle glass partition visually separates the bedroom from the living room, a feature sure to be appreciated by families with children.

The complex blends perfectly with the surrounding tropical environment, and a short walk to the beach promises true enjoyment. Just 5 minutes and you’ll find yourself on one of Phuket’s most breathtaking beaches – Nai Yang. This small, intimate beach stretches just under 3 kilometers, with waters protected by coral reefs, allowing you to enjoy swimming year-round, regardless of the season. Since 1986, the beach has been part of the Sirinath National Marine Park, where all motorized water sports are prohibited.

This complex is ideal both for permanent residence and for short vacations.

The Title Nai Yang is a modern resort complex, which consists of seven buildings of 6 and 7 floors and has 472 apartments: studios 36-39m2, one-bedroom apartments with an area of ​​46m2 or two bedrooms, the territory of the complex itself is fenced and is under 24-hour video surveillance and security ... The concept of the project and design is somewhat unusual for Thailand, the complex is decorated with red brick, and it looks more like a medieval castle than a modern Asian condominium. The apartments have a comfortable layout, in light grey and blue colours. The common area is a beautiful, well-groomed recreation park, a river flows along the buildings, which gives the project a certain charm and beauty of the fusion of modern urban architecture with nature.

The complex has its own restaurant, which serves breakfast, lunch and dinner a-la carte. Each building has access to a communal pool and well-kept garden. 5 swimming pools in each building are located on the 1st floor, and the sixth is on the roof of one of the buildings. There is a recreation area on the same roof. The complex offers a free gym, two saunas, a reception, a play area for children in the form of a pirate ship. Parking for 240 cars is organized on the south side of the building and is separated by green spaces and a fence.

The complex blends in perfectly with the tropical environment, and walking to the beach is a real pleasure. Just 5 minutes, and you will find yourself on one of the most stunning beaches in Phuket - Nai Yang. A small, cosy beach with a length of just under 3 kilometres, the water area of ​​which is protected by coral reefs, will allow you to enjoy swimming in the sea all year round, regardless of the season. Since 1986, this beach has been part of the Sirinath National Park Marine Park and all motor sports are prohibited on it. There is a large selection of restaurants, bars and cafés along the beach. The Title project itself separates the famous 5 * hotel The Slate from the beach with excellent gourmet restaurants. A five-minute walk is a local grocery market and mini markets.

The proximity to the sea and low prices make this project one of the most attractive on the island. And the peculiarity of the Nai Yang beach, on which there are never waves, even in low season, makes the project popular all year round. The entrance to the water is very shallow, so the beach is loved by families with small children. The low cost of apartments, both for rent and for purchase, makes the project accessible to everyone.

Nai Yang is a sought-after location in Phuket with convenient access to beaches, restaurants, services and tourist infrastructure.

Another new high-end complex in the south of the island has opened its doors for our clients. The complex began operations in November 2016 and is located just 600 meters from one of the island’s most stunning beaches – Nai Harn.

This beach is loved by everyone without exception; it is covered with white sand and features a gentle slope leading into the Andaman Sea. Usually, this beautiful beach is less crowded than the more popular spots, making it a quieter and more peaceful place to relax. Because of the gentle slope, it’s especially popular with mothers and children. If you’re traveling with a child and worry about feeling isolated, you can confidently choose this location, as you’ll always find playmates for your little one here. The walk to the sea takes about 15 minutes, most of which you’ll spend enjoying the beauty of a lovely nearby lake.

Numerous cafes and restaurants nearby offer a variety of cuisines including Italian, Thai, French, and Russian. If you prefer to cook for yourself, Phuket will impress you with the quality and variety of its products and spices. Just a few minutes’ drive away are the Macro and Villa Market grocery stores.

The complex offers several types of apartments with different sizes. We want to present you with the best accommodation option – spacious one-bedroom apartments measuring 36 sq.m., located on the second floor. They feature a bedroom with a king-size bed, a fully equipped modern kitchen with appliances and a dining area, and a cozy balcony furnished for relaxation. All apartments boast stylish design, quality furniture, LCD TVs, and a spacious bathroom.

For your convenience, the complex includes a swimming pool with sun loungers and a relaxation area, a fitness center, a reception and guest service desk, an elevator, parking, and 24-hour security. We are confident that you will be delighted if you choose to spend your vacation here.

Relife The Windy condominium is located in the south of Phuket, 800 meters from Nai Harn Beach and 10 minutes from Rawai. The project includes two buildings: Relife Сondo and Relife The Windy Condominium, which are opposite each other. The first building was commissioned in 2016 and has been popular with tourists for several years. On the territory of the condominium there is a swimming pool with a children's area and sun loungers, a gym, a restaurant, a lobby building, parking. The complex has several layout options for studio apartments, 1 and 2-bedroom apartments. Areas from 30 sq.m. to 58 sq.m.

ReLife The Windy Condominium is a seven-story building, 120 one-bedroom apartments in a Japanese loft style. Apartments ranging from 31 to 49 sq.m. There are several types of apartments in the condominium. Most of them overlook the garden and the surrounding area. Each apartment has a full kitchen, balcony, living-dining area, and a large bathroom. The interior is designed by designers in a modern style - Japanese loft. Built-in furniture made in Japanese style from New Zealand pine. The complex has two swimming pools. One with a sitting area downstairs and a second pool-bar with sun loungers and umbrellas on the roof of the building.

24-hour security, reception area, swimming pools with a relaxation area with sun loungers, underground parking, gym.

The complex is well located in relation to the entire tourist infrastructure of the Naiharn and Rawai areas. Within walking distance of cafés and restaurants, round the clock mini markets, massage parlours, laundries. One of the best beaches - Naiharn is located a kilometre from the project. The beach is popular with families with children and expats, so you will not find a large crowd of tourists here. A stone's throw from the beach, there is a freshwater lake and an observation deck with windmills. Nai Harn Beach is popular with families with children, as well as with winterers and long-livers of the island. It is comfortable to spend your vacation here, because Nearby there are many restaurants of both European and national Thai cuisine. There are also offices with transport rental and excursion services. For a long stay on Naiharn, it is comfortable to live for families with children - there are international and Thai kindergartens, international and Russian schools nearby. The way from Naiharn to the popular children's play complex "Rawai Park" will take 5 minutes by car or bike. Naiharn is also often chosen for yoga tours or sports camping. At Naiharn and in the neighbouring Rawai district, there are gyms, specialized rings for Thai boxing and workout grounds. Within a 7-10 minute drive there is a Macro hypermarket, a supermarket with European products Villa Market, a fish market.

The complex is suitable for families with children and the category of tourists who prefer active recreation. Also, due to the availability of the beach and tourist infrastructure, it will be comfortable here for those who prefer not to take a vehicle for the duration of their holiday.

Kata is one of the most popular tourist beaches, but there are no nightclubs and almost no bars, so it is quite calm at night. This area is often chosen for families. And if you go up the road from the apartment, then there you will find a viewpoint overlooking Kata Noi, Kata and Karon, and this road itself leads to Nai Harn Beach. The residences are very spacious and are ideal not only for relaxation, but also for long-term living. tenancy rules, deposit and contract terms, and what daily life around the property actually looks like.

This is general guidance — InDreams Phuket recommends reading the lease in full and asking for

Renting is open to foreigners without the quota and structuring rules that govern

purchases. Any valid visa — tourist, Thailand Privilege, LTR, Non-Immigrant B or O —

Leases of up to three years take effect on signature and need no Land Office registration.

A term longer than three years must be registered at the Land Office, otherwise it is

Thai law requires the property owner or manager to file a TM30 notification of your

address with Immigration within 24 hours of check-in. Ask for a copy: it is routinely

requested when extending a visa, filing 90-day reports, opening a bank account or

Holders of long-stay visas file a 90-day address report throughout their stay.

A new TM30 is needed each time you change address, including after travel abroad

Owner accepts bookings from 3 nights upwards, which keeps it open to short stays as well as long-term contracts.

Security deposit — two months' rent on annual contracts, one month on

shorter terms. Refundable within 30 days of check-out, less any documented damage.

Advance rent — the first month is paid on signing, alongside the deposit.

Standard term — twelve months with an option to renew, commonly written

as 1+1. Six-month contracts are available on many properties at a higher monthly rate.

Inventory — insist on a signed inventory with photographs at check-in.

It is the single most effective protection for your deposit.

Early termination — most leases forfeit the deposit if you leave early,

so negotiate a diplomatic clause before signing if your plans may change.

Long-stay properties in Phuket are let furnished as standard, with white goods,

air conditioning and basic kitchenware in place. Confirm the inventory before signing.

Where utilities are not included, electricity is metered and billed at the provider rate

for private landlords, or at a building rate in some condominiums — worth checking, as the

two can differ noticeably over a hot-season month with air conditioning running.

The villa features three bedrooms, a living room, and a fully equipped kitchen. The open-plan living area combines the kitchen and dining space. Trichada Villas - the project consists of modern villas, which was built near the Laguna Phuket resort in 2017 and is still a favourite place for expats and guests to relax in Phuket. The project is quiet and peaceful due to its location, away from the hustle and bustle of more congested areas of Phuket such as Patong Beach. The architecture is simple and fresh, with a white color palette and many tropical plants and flowers. There are 25 villas in the project. Villas with private large pools and tropical gardens around the villas. You may enjoy a sun lounger outdoors or dine with your family in the al fresco dining area. Trichada consists of one-story pool villas set in lush tropical gardens. The villas consist of 2 or 3 bedrooms, ranging from 100 to 150 sq. m., which are located on a plot ranging from 280 to 490 sq. m., respectively, each with its own swimming pool and parking. The concept of the project is to provide a relaxing atmosphere and feel at home. The developer has developed a plan for the one-story villas in order to provide you with the complete privacy of your home in Phuket.

Trichada Complex is a 10-minute drive from Bangtao Beach. This beach is where Phuket's most popular beach clubs are located, such as Xana Beach Club, Dream Beach Club and Catch Club. Not far from Trichada, Blue Tree is located - this is a large entertainment complex that includes: the lagoon of the water park itself with various attractions on water and land, several large parking lots, a helipad, a kids club, a fitness area, a shopping center, restaurants and mobile tents with food ... Blue tree Phuket Water Park opened its doors in the fall of 2019 in the north of the island, not far from Bangtao Beach. And he is already one of the top attractions in Phuket. The park is suitable for visitors of all ages, especially children. An active day for the whole family is guaranteed! Boat Avenue is a 10-minute drive from Trichada, with a variety of shops, countless restaurants and bars, and Villa Market, a European supermarket. The modern Porto De Phuket shopping complex, with countless restaurants, Tors supermarket, boutiques and food court, is just a short drive away.
